# kratos-admin

`kratos-admin`is a front-end and back-end separated management system repository, including Go + Kratos back-end, Vue management back-end, uni-app application base, React/Taro application base, versioned database migration, and module scaffolding.

## Implemented capability

- Account password, verification code, OAuth, TOTP/WebAuthn multi-factor authentication, JWT refresh, tenant and Casbin permissions.
-TOTP multi-factor authentication, one-time recovery code and `disabled`, `optional`, `all_required`global policies.
- Open Authorization Client Management: Clients are bound by tenants, credentials are exchanged for Bearer tokens, and the tenant, status, IP whitelist, JSON API whitelist, and protocol ciphertext are verified by the operation interceptor and HTTP encryption and decryption Filter.
- User, role, department, position, menu, dictionary, configuration, task, file asset, log, region, API and migration record management.
- The background workbench provides an overview of users/roles, login trends, login results, and statistics on the distribution of operation actions.
- Message Classification, tenant in-direction/All-staff in-site messages, inbox read/Archived, Redis delivery Recovery and Admin/uni-app/Taro Message Center.
- Proto-driven HTTP, gRPC, OpenAPI, Agent Tool, MCP Tool and TypeScript RPC generation.
-AI sessions, streaming messages, attachments, tool calls, retries, regeneration and branch sessions.
- Management end code generation configuration, preview, generation progress and restore.
- Run Log Browsing: Real-time console SSE, historical log query, level and keyword filtering, and historical original file download.
- Login source Policy (global and tenant/user orientation rules), password complexity policy, current session revocation, asynchronous database landing and retention cleaning of audit logs, controlled MySQL backup and recovery tasks.
- During the build period, collect the README/docs of the current project, host project, and external modules, and view them uniformly on the management end.
- Mounted Go Core module; The backend implements `module.Module`, provides static resources through `Resources`, and is handed over to Core through the startup entry for unified registration of protocol services.
- The language collection of the management end, uni-app, Taro and backend error directories is automatically discovered by the language pack; Dynamic menus, dictionaries and code generation are synchronized to support all registered languages.

warehouse does not include business modules such as the mall, orders, payments, or recommendations.

## Starts locally

First create the database:

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

Install front-end dependencies:

```bash
make -C frontend init
```

If the dependent directory needs to be completely rebuilt:

```bash
make -C frontend reinstall
```

启动后端：

```bash
make -C backend run APP_ENV=dev
```

`run`will first refresh the interfaces, OpenAPI and Wire products required for startup. When it is confirmed that the generated product has not changed, `make -C backend run-only APP_ENV=dev`can be used to start directly. For basic configuration, use `<name>.yaml`; for environmental differences, use `<name>.<env>.yaml`. Automatically revert to basic configuration when the current environment file is missing. The complete target, execution sequence, and parameters can be found in [Common Backend Processes ](backend/README.md#常用流程)

```bash
make -C frontend run
```

can also be started by terminal (each resident command should run in an independent terminal) :

```bash
make -C frontend run-admin
cd frontend/uni-app && pnpm dev:h5
cd ../taro-app && pnpm dev:h5
```

uni-app and Taro H5 use `5004`and `5002`by default respectively, and they can be started simultaneously. When a local area network device accesses uni-app, replace `localhost`with the local area network IP of the development machine.

make gen
make check
make build
make -C backend fmt

The root directory `make build`builds the backend binary and three front-end H5 hosts. For building only the entire front end (H5 + wechat mini-program), `make -C frontend build`can be used. For building only H5, `make -C frontend build-h5`is used. For generating all npm release packages, `make -C frontend package`is used.

`make -C backend cli`will install `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`and `make -C backend fmt`. Then run this command and use `goimports`to format all the Backend Go files.

The `make package`in the root directory of the repository will generate a backend release compressed package containing `bin/server`and `configs`, and simultaneously generate all the front-end npm packages. The target platform can be overridden by `GOOS`and `GOARCH`.

Docker image is built using the command from the repository root directory:

```bash
make docker-build IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
make docker-run IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest APP_ENV=dev
make docker-stop IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
```

build command first checks Docker, and then builds the management backend, uni-app H5, Taro H5 and the Linux backend program. Run the command to publish the host machine's `7001/6001`port, map `backend/data`to `/app/data`, and for the first time initialize the `backend/runtime/configs`that can be modified on the host machine and map it to `/app/configs`. The three-terminal static site is released along with the image and merged into `/app/data`at startup. Existing uploaded files will not be cleared. For the complete build parameters and run examples, please refer to this section.

`make i18n-openapi`will generate `openapi.en-US.yaml`, `openapi.zh-TW.yaml`and `openapi.ja-JP.yaml`simultaneously after generating `openapi.yaml`. The default resources come from the error directory at the back end and the Core language pack at the management end. External resources can be passed in through `OPENAPI_I18N_CONTENT="locale=path"`. Missed copy will be automatically translated by default: Google V1 will be used for English and Japanese, and OpenCC for traditional Chinese. Setting `I18N_AUTO_LOCALIZE=0`can disable automatic translation. Use `I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n-openapi`in an environment without network connection.

## Internationalization

language pack defines the collection of languages that the system can render, while the `base_language`table is only responsible for runtime enabling status, name, sorting, and main language configuration. The language preference of the management end is saved as `kratos-admin:locale`, and uni-app and Taro are saved as `kratos-app:locale`. All HTTP, refresh token, fetch, SSE, uni.request and tarant.request requests will send the normalized `Accept-Language`. Fixed copy is maintained by the core/System JSON language packs of each workspace. Dynamic menus and dictionaries are parsed by the backend translation table according to the requested language. When the current language translation is missing, the main language is reverted.

The script validates the language set, language keys and placeholders, and generates six front-end registration files, Element Plus and Day.js mappings. The language name, sorting, enabled status and main language are provided by the `base_language`database record; `common.language.*`is used for offline display at compile time and the initial name for generating language migration. The complete list of files for the newly added languages and the migration process can be found in the [International Language Extension Guide ](docs/国际化语言扩展指南.md). When a language needs to be added to a newly deployed database, directly update the unique `v0.0.1`initialization migration; the enabled status of existing databases will not be overwritten by the migration.

When creating or updating menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries, and system configurations, the back end converts the input text into the main language as requested by `Accept-Language`and writes it into the main table. When the requested language is not the main language, the original text is written into the corresponding translation table, and other enabled non-main languages are only saved in the translation table. The system configuration name, menu title, dictionary name and dictionary item label support clicking the name on the management end to open the translation pop-up window. The text/rich text configuration value supports runtime translation fallback.

# backend

Backend simultaneously offers message classification, in-site message management, user inbox, Redis delivery recovery, backend workbench statistics, file asset metadata, login source policy, session undo, asynchronous audit event write-off, log retention and cleaning, and controlled database backup tasks. The default data for security, messaging, and open authorization is uniformly provided by the `v0.0.1`initialization migration.

`backend`retains the API contract, Go generation interface, Service implementation, Biz business layer, as well as task scheduling, HTTP/gRPC/MCP/AI registration and necessary data access closures. The process entry is located at `internal/cmd/server`. The root package provides a common boundary that can be reused by external Core hosts through `ProviderSet`, `NewModuleResources`, `NewModules`, `NewTasks`, `NewStreams`and `NewQueueConsumers`. `internal/module`only carries the internal implementation. The AI Runtime is implemented in `internal/biz`, and the external reuse entry is `pkg/agent`. The business module publishes in-site messages via `pkg/notification.Publish`, and the internal affairs and Dispatch recovery link are responsible for the final delivery. The open authorization client uses the single-table JSON operation whitelist and binds the tenant, and the public endpoint issues the client Bearer Token. HTTP middleware separately verifies tenants, status, IP whitelist and API range. HTTP encryption and decryption Filter decrypts client data before request binding and encrypts it after a successful response. Login authentication supports TOTP multi-factor authentication, one-time recovery codes, as well as global and tenant/user targeted login source policies.

##

```text
backend
├── internal/cmd/server             # Admin 独立启动入口与 Wire 组合根
├── api
│   ├── proto                         # Proto 契约
│   └── gen/go                        # Buf 生成的 Go 接口、HTTP、gRPC 和工具代码
├── internal/biz                      # 业务 Case、DTO、代码生成和辅助领域代码
├── bootstrap.go                      # 对外 ProviderSet 和模块/任务/SSE/队列/资源入口
├── internal/module                   # Admin 到 kratos-core 的内部模块适配和资源实现
│   ├── module.go                     # Core Module 协议注册
│   ├── resources.go                  # module.Module 静态资源
│   ├── init.go                        # Admin 模块 ProviderSet
│   └── wire.go / wire_gen.go          # 公共入口使用的内部依赖装配
├── pkg/agent                         # 对外复用的 AI Runtime、模型和工具 API
├── pkg/runtimeconfig                  # 对外复用的运行配置 Proto 注册、校验和缓存 API
├── pkg/notification                  # 对外复用的站内信发布 API
├── internal/task                     # 异步任务与定时任务执行器
├── internal/server                   # 服务拦截器和 API 模块注册适配
│   └── middleware/{oauth,logstream}  # 按业务分组的 HTTP/gRPC 服务拦截器
├── internal/data/gen                 # GORM 生成的模型、查询和仓储
├── internal/service                  # Proto Service 实现
├── internal/const                    # 业务常量
├── internal/i18n/assets              # 业务语言资源
└── migration                         # 代码生成业务使用的迁移资源
```

## Common process

After entering the `backend`directory, first use the help to view all targets, default parameter values, and overwrite examples:

```bash
make help
```

is the first to develop and install Buf, protoc, Wire, gorm-gen, goimports and inspection tools:

```bash
make init
```

```bash

```

`make run`will refresh the necessary products in the order of "protobuf Go -> OpenAPI -> Independent entry Wire -> Start Service". When it is confirmed that the generated product has not changed, the generation can be skipped and started directly

```bash
make run-only
```

is `./configs`, and the default runtime environment is `dev`. For basic configuration, use `<name>.yaml`; for environmental differences, use `<name>.<env>.yaml`. When the environment file exists, it is loaded after the basic configuration; when it does not exist, the basic configuration is rolled back. The configuration directory, operating environment or additional startup parameters can be overwritten

and the upload security scan are configured using `authn.session`and `oss.upload_security`. Audit logs are retained in "System Management → Backup Management → Data Archiving" and maintained by table, while database backups are maintained by data source in "System Management → Backup Management → Data Backup". The log entry rollback configuration uses the hidden configuration `auditLogSpool`alone; The backup integrity key and the encryption key are respectively derived from the runtime key service as `kratos-admin:backup/integrity`and `kratos-admin:backup/encryption`when specific tasks are executed. The general system configuration is still maintained by the "System Configuration" page. HTTP regular requests only use `server.http.timeout`and `server.http.max_body_bytes`. `/events`, `/mcp`and the AI message flow automatically skip the regular request timeout.

is selected by the system configuration `securityMfaMethod`. Currently, `totp`and `webauthn`are supported. The runtime MFA parameters are loaded through the `mfa.yaml`or the `mfa`node of the environment overwrite file `mfa.dev.yaml`. `mfa.encryption_key`is preferred when it has an explicit value. When left blank, it is derived from the runtime key service as `kratos-kit:mfa/encryption`during the actual encryption and decryption of the TOTP key. To disable TOTP on the management end and application end, the current password and dynamic password or recovery code are required. To disable WebAuthn, the current password and a Passkey or recovery code verification are needed. Do not write the real key into the warehouse or database in the production environment. The complete field is subject to `kratos-kit/api/proto/config/v1/mfa.proto`.

```bash

make run-only APP_ENV=prod
make run-only RUN_ARGS='--help'
```

independent entry injects `kratoscore.ProviderSet`and the internal module ProviderSet; Core is responsible for uniformly creating and managing HTTP, gRPC, MCP, SSE, queues, and scheduled task runtimes. The Admin registers six complete audit log models and is responsible for automatic migration. Core asynchronously writes API/ policy logs, while Admin asynchronously writes login, operation, data access and permission logs.

scheduled task acquires the Redis distributed lock by task number before each execution. The scheduled trigger skips the lock when it is held by another instance, and a lock race error is returned when executed manually. When Redis lock initialization fails, it will record a warning and downgrade to an in-process memory lock. This mode is only applicable to single-instance operation. For multi-instance deployment, it is necessary to ensure that each instance is connected to the same Redis and is in Redis lock mode.

The directory where the independent entry

## External host reuse

```go
func NewApp(ctx *bootstrap.Context) (*kratos.App, func(), error) {
	panic(wire.Build(

		backend.ProviderSet,

The host's merged ProviderSet explicitly appoints their contributions along with those of other business modules to the Core final set. The public constructor only uses the Core public type, and the externally generated `wire_gen.go`does not depend on `backend/internal`.

`backend.NewModules`initializes the host process-level operation log collector. After external projects are connected to the Backend in the above-mentioned way, the logs written by themselves and other registered modules to stdout/stderr will also enter the real-time console for running logs, and the historical log files will be read according to the host's log configuration.

`configs/auth.yaml`is preferred when it has an explicit value. When left blank, both the server and the client jointly derive from the runtime key service by pressing `kratos-kit:authn/jwt`. Sensitive values in the configuration file should be saved using `ENC[...]`, and plaintext keys should not be submitted.

management browser uses the cookie-only refresh token mode: the refresh token is only saved in the HttpOnly Cookie with a narrowed Path, and the access token is only saved in the page memory. uni-app and Taro do not send this mode identifier and continue to use their respective existing token transmission methods.

is connected to AI, the runtime is created using `pkg/agent.NewRuntime`, and Eino `InvokableTool`is registered through `RuntimeConfig.AdminTools/AppTools`or `Runtime.RegisterTool`. is connected to run the configuration, define the configuration message in your own Proto and register the key, default value and sensitive fields through `pkg/runtimeconfig.Register`. The validation rule ID can be directly used as an internationalized message key. The universal boot configuration prioritizes the reuse of `config.v1.Bootstrap`from `kratos-kit/api`, such as `authn.session`, `oss.upload_security`, `logger`and `data`.

# AI Assistant

AI assistant is a shared session capability among the management end, uni-app, and Taro application end. The three entry points use the same set of `base.v1`interfaces and data tables, but the available tools and quick entry points are filtered by terminal.

## Implemented capability

- Session creation, listing, renaming, deletion, and persistence branches.
- Message list, text and attachment sending, edit the last message, Delete, retry failure and regenerate.
Direct streaming responses to three types of SSE events:
-`delta`, `finish`, and `error`.
- Markdown, model source, Token, time consumption of the first Token, total time consumption and tool call records.
- Agent Tool generated by filtering terminals, interface switches and user permissions.
- Fixed process quick entry and Structured actions; Old message actions will be judged as expired by the server.
- Responses Server-side tool logging; A clear unavailable error is returned when the current model is not enabled.

## Contract and data

: Capability: Proto: HTTP prefix
| --- | --- | --- |
: Quick access: `backend/api/proto/base/v1/ai_tool.proto`: `/api/v1/base/ai/shortcut`
: Session: `ai_session.proto`: `/api/v1/base/ai/session`
: Message: `ai_message.proto`: `/api/v1/base/ai/session/{session_id}/message`

is persisted to `ai_session`and `ai_message`. One round of message saves input, output, attachments, tools, tokens, time consumption, status and optional structured process content. The action must carry the current latest success message of `source_message_id`, `action_id`and `flow_version`.

directly returns `text/event-stream`without using the general `/events/{stream}`subscription. At the end of the stream, the `finish`event returns the final message and the updated session.

## Backend link.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  API["AiMessageService"] --> Case["AiMessageCase"]
  Case --> Runtime["biz/base/ai.Runtime"]
  Runtime --> ADK["internal/biz/agent/adk"]
  ADK --> Model["Eino Agentic Model"]
  ADK --> Tools["按终端和权限筛选的工具"]
  Case --> DB[("ai_session / ai_message")]
```

`internal/biz/base/ai`is responsible for business protocols, historical messages, attachments, terminal policies, fixed processes, and result persistence. `internal/biz/agent`isolates the model, message, ADK, Middleware, Callback, Tool, Structured and Workflow details of Eino.

Agent Tool comes from the generated code, and `agent_status`controls whether it can be used by AI. `mcp_status`independently controls whether it is exposed as an MCP Tool. The two are not the same switch.

## Management end

management terminal is located at `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/ai/chat`:

File Responsibilities
| --- | --- |
: `index.vue`: Session, message, send and action master orchestration. |
: `components/SessionPanel.vue`: Session search, creation, switching, renaming and deletion. |
: `components/ChatPanel.vue`: Message area, empty state, quick entry and message operations. |
: `components/XSender.vue`: Text, attachments and sending status. |
: `components/AiMarkdown.vue`: Markdown and code content. |
, `stream.ts`, `message.ts`, SSE parsing and message state normalization. |

System module also registers the AI icon as the top tool. Structured process block components are not built-in fixed implementations; Other business modules can provide the `flowBlocks`extension through `ADMIN_AI_EXTENSION`.

## Application side

uni-app is located at `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai`, and Taro is located at `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai`. Both ends offer session drawers, welcome quick entry, input and attachments, message flow, and multi-terminal SSE parsing. The page belongs to the `pagesMember`package and uses the same `base.v1`RPC and API encapsulation. H5 uses Fetch SSE; Wechat Mini Programs utilize the block request capabilities of their respective platforms.

## Configuration and verification

model is located at `backend/configs/ai.yaml`, and the difference in the development environment is at `backend/configs/ai.dev.yaml`. The service can still start when the complete model configuration is not provided, but the AI runtime is turned off.

. Modify the execution of `pnpm lint:oxlint`and `pnpm type:check`on the management end; Modify uni-app or Taro to execute the `pnpm lint`and `pnpm tsc`corresponding to the workspace. When module protocols or runners are involved, execute `pnpm test`and `pnpm check:exports`. The front end should at least check the status of empty sessions, historical sessions, sending in progress, failed, attachments, and expired process actions.

documents.content:
# International design

This article describes the internationalization boundaries, runtime behaviors, and data responsibilities that the warehouse has currently implemented. The specific operations for the newly added languages shall be subject to the [International Language Extension Guide ](国际化语言扩展指南.md).

## Current conclusion

: Content: Current Implementation
| --- | --- |
: Fixed language packs: `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `en-US`, `ja-JP`
; default language at compile time; `zh-CN`
: Dynamic resource main language is determined by `base_language.is_primary`
: Fixed Copy: core/System JSON language packs for three front-end Workspaces
: Backend error: Structured JSON directory of `backend/internal/i18n/assets`
: Runtime language options: The enabled language returned by the `base_language`interface
: Dynamic Resources: Menu, Dictionary, Dictionary Entry and System Configuration Name/Value Translation Table
: Machine translation: Can generate and save blank translations as needed; Existing non-empty translations will not cover

does not mean putting all language names or translation constants into the database. The database is responsible for deployment and configuration, while the language pack is responsible for compiling the whitelist and fixed documentation during the compilation period. New languages must update two layers simultaneously.

## Runtime link

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Files["语言包 JSON"] --> Sync["scripts/sync_locales.py"]
  Sync --> UI["固定 UI 与错误目录"]
  DB["base_language"] --> Options["运行时语言选项"]
  Request["Accept-Language"] --> Locale["locale 规范化"]
  Locale --> UI
  Locale --> Dynamic["动态菜单/字典/配置解析"]
  Dynamic --> Tables[("翻译表")]
```

### compile-time language collection

`scripts/sync_locales.py`; The code generator copy is also uniformly stored in the backend language directory and verified through the `system.code.gen.*`prefix:

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
```

must be consistent. The `system.code.gen.*`key in the backend language file is directly reused by the code generator. The script generates six front-end `generated.ts`and verifies the locale mappings of the management end Day.js and Element Plus. Core's `resource/i18n`receives host language resources. Core is responsible for directory loading and error localization internally and does not embed project entries. The generated file cannot be modified manually.

### Runtime language configuration

`base_language`Save:

- `language_code`: Standard BCP 47 language code;
- `language_name`, `native_name`: Names displayed on the management end and login page;
-`status`, `sort`: Optional and display sequence;
-`is_primary`: The main language for dynamic menus, dictionaries, and system configurations.

starts up, it first uses the compile-time package to establish a fallback language list, and then requests the common language interface. When the database interface is successful, the enabled language and sorting will be taken as the standard; when it fails, the compile-time language list will be rolled back. The deployment configuration should only enable the languages that have been released with the package. The database records themselves will not generate missing language packs.

### Request and rollback

manages Axios, refresh tokens, fetch, SSE and Swagger requests, as well as uni-app/Taro requests, uploads and SSE, and uniformly sends the standardized `Accept-Language`. The backend matches the area according to the whitelist. If the value is unknown, it will revert to `zh-CN`.

is as follows:

```text
固定 UI：当前语言 -> zh-CN -> 安全默认文案
菜单/字典/配置：当前语言非空翻译 -> 主表主语言字段 -> 稳定 code/path
错误：当前语言 message_key -> zh-CN message_key -> 原始安全消息 -> INTERNAL_ERROR
```

is running, it does not display raw keys, unsaved machine translation results, database errors, SQL, or responses from third-party providers.

## Fixed copy and error directory

Each front-end module maintains its own JSON language package. When a module is registered, the language set, key, namespace, and placeholder are verified. core maintains general capabilities, while System maintains system management, personal centers, and AI copywriting. A module is not allowed to directly modify the language pack of another module.

backend is loaded by `kratos-core/resource/i18n`. The `id/message`of Proto `buf.validate`and the explicit `WithMessageKey`in Go must be defined in `zh-CN.json`, and the same key and placeholder should be maintained in other languages. The inspection command is:

```bash
make i18n-check
```

error keeps the existing `code/reason`externally and only supplements the stable `message_key/message_args`in the metadata. The response boundary renders `message`in the requested language.

## Front-end and back-end Key naming conventions

use the same set of hierarchical ideas, but retain the naming sources of their respective code ecosystems: the front-end fixed copy generates business paths from component names, while the back-end errors generate business paths from Proto packages and services. The Key is a stable technical identifier that does not contain Chinese characters and is not named based on translation results.

### front-end fixed copywriting

uses the following format:

```text
<模块>.<组件业务路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
```

component comes from `defineOptions.name`. Split the PascalCase name into lowercase dot path:

```text
BaseDict      -> base.dict
BaseDictItem  -> base.dict.item
CodeGenTable  -> code.gen.table
BaseTenant    -> base.tenant
```

示例：

```text
system.base.dict.title.create
system.base.dict.field.created_at
system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
system.base.dict.message.create_success
system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

Copy type uses a fixed set: `title`, `field`, `section`, `action`, `placeholder`, `validation`, `dialog`, `message`, `error`, ZZZ TOKEN0009, `value`, `tooltip`, `empty`. The names and fields should uniformly use `snake_case`, for example, `confirm_status`, `created_at`, `create_success`. `status`

without repeatedly adding business paths: `common.*`

```text
common.action.create
common.field.created_at
common.validation.required_input
```

uses the above-mentioned dot path. The current runtime and check code are still read as flat keys. If JSON is to be changed to a nested object, the synchronization script, module registration and product generation must be modified simultaneously. The JSON shape cannot be changed manually only.

### backend error message

backend `message_key`uses the following format:

```text
<package 去掉版本>.<Service 业务路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

Proto package", remove the version number. For the "Service", after removing "`Service`", split it into lowercase dot paths according to PascalCase:

```text
system.admin.v1 + BaseDictService -> system.admin.base.dict
system.admin.v1 + CodeGenTableService -> system.admin.code.gen.table
base.v1 + LoginService -> base.login
```

示例：

```text
system.admin.base.dict.entity.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.update.id.required
system.admin.code.gen.table.field.page_type.required
```

and `entity`represent the verification of the entity itself, while other values indicate specific operations. Field names and rule names use Proto-style `snake_case`. The name of the rule should remain stable Priority use `required`, `max_length`, `min_length`, `format`, `pattern`, `positive`, `non_negative`, `unique`, `supported`Such fixed words.

General error does not bind specific Service:

```text
common.error.invalid_argument
common.error.permission_denied
```

version number `v1`does not enter the key; `message_key`will return with error responses and is an external stable contract. Renaming must be synchronized with Proto, Go, all language directories, and the caller.

### Front-end and back-end correspondence

do not require the use of exactly the same key, but the business paths should correspond to each other

```text
前端：system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
后端：system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
```

use the target type and number of `base_i18n`, and do not reuse the fixed copy key.

## Dynamic resource translation

dynamic resources share one translation table `base_i18n`, and the target resources are distinguished by `target_type`:

: `target_type`: Main table: Translatable fields
| --- | --- | --- |
: `1`: `base_config`: Text and rich text configuration values
: `2`: `base_config`: System configuration name
: `3`: `base_dict`: Dictionary Name
: `4`: `base_dict_item`: Dictionary entry label
; `5`; `base_menu`; Menu title
: `6`: `base_job`: Scheduled task name
: `7`: `base_migration`: Migration Instructions

, `base_dict.code`and `base_dict_item.value`are stable business identifiers and do not enter the translation table. The dictionary name and dictionary entry label correspond respectively to `3`and `4`, and the system configuration name and value correspond respectively to `2`and `1`.

, the main language text is written to the main table. Manually entered non-primary language text is directly written into `base_i18n`. Unentered languages are supplemented by translation tasks, and existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten. The main language is not saved repeatedly in the translation table. When missing, it reverts to the main table.

are located in the same version `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`. The migration uses idempotent `INSERT IGNORE`and will not overwrite the already maintained data. The executed version cannot be fixed by rewriting the file; a new version migration must be added.

## Machine translation

service runtime is achieved by pressing `backend/configs/translator.yaml`to select the Provider through `kratos-kit/translator`. The entry points include:

- Management end `BaseI18nService.DraftBaseI18n`: Generate and save a single translation for saved menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries, or configurations.
- After the menu, dictionary, dictionary entry and configuration are successfully created or updated: First, deliver the resource message to the asynchronous translation queue; When queue consumption fails, the scheduled task scans the translation to be processed as a safety net.
- When the management-end editor submits an empty text or discovers a missing translation when the list name hovers over it, it will immediately fill it up through the same interface. The non-blank translations filled in manually remain unchanged.

are generated by `make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>`calling an independent script and do not belong to the normal service request chain.

translation interface is disabled by default. It can be enabled through `translator.enabled=true`, `I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true`, or by applying metadata. The server reads the controlled source text, with the target language limited to the enabled language. It serially calls and uses the HTTP timeout configured by `translator.timeout`(default 8 seconds). Existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten. System configuration names and values of text and rich text types will enter machine translation, while images and Boolean values will not be sent out.

Provider is only for translation and cannot be used for login, error response, ordinary CRUD, or any text translation proxy. When Provider is unavailable, fixed language packs, existing translations, and main language fallbacks must still function properly.

## Code generation

code generator reuses the `common.*`universal template from `backend/internal/i18n/assets/<locale>.json`and uses `system.code.gen.*`to save the code and generate exclusive process copy and terms. At the same time, read the business name and field name from the table-level and field-level `i18n_config`. The generation page will write the stable keys of all compile-time languages. When non-primary languages lack necessary configurations, they should be completed before formal generation and the missing items should be displayed in the preview.

generator must not directly write new Chinese UI copy into Vue, Proto, or menu SQL. The generated result falls within the key range of the current code generation object and cannot override other modules or manually maintained translations.

## Database migration

New language or new translation directly supplements the unique `v0.0.1`initialization migration:

```text
backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql/
├── README.md
├── README.<locale>.md
├── language.up.sql
└── i18n.<locale>.up.sql
```

`make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=v0.0.1`generates the initialization record of `base_language`; By default, `make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>`writes dynamic translation SQL to the current `v0.0.1`. The generator only creates `README.md`when the directory has no description yet. The description of the existing directory needs to be updated manually according to the actual script. The existing `README.<locale>.md`should also be updated synchronously. Do not create an empty file when there is no corresponding language description.

and `base_language`are deployment configurations and should not be forcibly overridden by re-executing the language pack synchronization script. The database that has executed `v0.0.1`will not automatically replay the modified initialization script. Verification should use a brand new database or be rebuilt according to the development environment process.

## Verification checklist

should at least check:

1. `make i18n-check`and `make i18n-sync`pass.
2. The key and placeholder verifications of the management end, uni-app, and Taro are successful.
3. When the language interface fails, the compile-time fallback list can still be used on all three ends.
4. Language selection can be restored before login, after login, by refreshing and reopening the application.
5. Menus, dictionaries, and configurations can all be correctly rolled back when there are non-empty translations, missing translations, or when the main language is switched.
6. The reasons for verification, authentication, permission, and resource errors remain unchanged; only the message is localized.
7. `go test ./...`and the type check of the affected workspace, lint passed.

can be found in the [International Language Extension Guide ](国际化语言扩展指南.md)

# Internationalized Language Extension Guide

This article is the implementation manual for the new language. The current fixed language set is `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `en-US`, and `ja-JP`. When a new language is added, the compile-time language pack determines "which language the code can render", while the `base_language`data only determines "which language is enabled in the current deployment, how it is sorted, and which language is the main language of the dynamic resource".

## First, understand the two layers of responsibilities

Layer: Authoritative source: Function
| --- | --- | --- |
: Compilation period: Backend error directory, three-end core/System JSON, code generation directory: Language whitelist, fixed UI copy, error copy, code generation template
: Runtime: `base_language`Table: Language Name, native name, enabled status, sort, Primary language

Therefore, adding only one language record to the database cannot allow a new language to appear on the page. Adding only the front-end JSON does not allow dynamic menus, dictionaries, and login pages to read this language. The two layers must be synchronized.

## Files to be added

, a JSON file with the same name must be used in the following seven language pack directories. The code generator copy is also merged into the backend language file:

: Table of Contents
| --- | --- |
: `backend/internal/i18n/assets`: Backend error message directory
: `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales`: Management End base and public copy
/ `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales`/ Management End System Copywriting
: `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales`: uni-app base and public copy
: `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales`: uni-app System copywriter
: `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales`: Taro Base and public copy
: `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales`: Taro System Copywriter
The key, placeholder and namespace of
JSON must remain unchanged. `common.language.<locale>`is used for offline display of language names and can be supplemented. Runtime names are read from the database first, so adding a new language does not require modifying existing language packs or TypeScript registration code.

## Key

, first determine the module and component it belongs to, and then name it according to the uniform rule:

```text
前端：<模块>.<defineOptions.name 转换路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
后端：<package 去掉版本>.<Service 转换路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

示例：

```text
BaseDict -> system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
BaseDictService / system.admin.v1 -> system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
CodeGenTable -> system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

are split into lowercase dot paths according to PascalCase. The end names, fields and rules uniformly use `snake_case`. Cross-business public copywriting uses `common.*`, and backend general errors use `common.error.*`. The backend key does not contain `v1`; Renaming `message_key`requires synchronization of Proto, Go and all language directories.

## Standard procedure

### 1. Select the language code

uses the BCP 47 form, such as `de-DE`and `pt-BR`. The language code must be consistent across all directories and cannot be represented by both `de`and `de-DE`simultaneously. The code needs to be parsed by the `resource/i18n`language resource directory of Core, and the Day.js and Element Plus locale dependencies on the management side can find the corresponding region or base language mapping.

### 2. Add language packs

takes `zh-CN.json`as the key reference, adds `<locale>.json`to the seven directories in the above table, and translates the value item by item

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
```

is directly written into `backend/internal/i18n/assets/<locale>.json`, using the prefix `system.code.gen.*`. When generating new code copy, modify all backend language files simultaneously and retain the set of placeholders.

and `common.language.<locale>`can be written to the Core language package on the management end, which is used to display the language name offline and generate the initial name for the migration of `base_language`. The runtime language name, sorting, and enabled status are still subject to the database records. Adding a new language does not require modifying the language name key in the existing language pack.

must retain placeholders such as `{name}`, `{field}`, `{max}`, and `{{.Value}}`, as well as the URL, permission path, dictionary code/value, and HTML/Markdown Label. Do not translate routes `name`, `path`, `component`or API paths.

### 3. Run the synchronization script

in the root directory of the repository:

```bash
make i18n-sync
```

script will check:

- Whether the file collections of the seven language pack directories are consistent;
- Whether the key set and placeholders of each language pack are consistent;
- Is the language directory field of the code generator complete?
- Manage whether there is an available mapping between Day.js and Element Plus.

check is passed, the script generates the following file. Do not edit it manually

- `src/locales/generated.ts`for six front-end packages;
- Management end Day.js, Element Plus locale mapping;
- Generate `language.up.sql`and the documentation when passing in the migration version.

### 4. Generate database language records

is uniformly migrated using `v0.0.1`. Write this version when generating language initialization records:

```bash
make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=v0.0.1
```

script is only responsible for supplementing the `base_language`record. When using `INSERT IGNORE`, it will not overwrite the enabled status, sorting, and main language configuration of the existing deployment. Before submission, check the migration version directory to ensure that `language.up.sql`is submitted along with the documentation.

to enable the language immediately during deployment, you can disable `base_language.status`after migration. The main language can only be switched through the language configuration or database configuration on the management end, and cannot be changed through the front-end language pack.

### 5. Prepare dynamic resource translation (optional)

fixed UI and backend error package is complete, the new language can roll back to the main language at runtime. To provide fixed translations for built-in menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries, and system configurations, you can use batch scripts to generate language packs and dynamic translation data:

```bash
I18N_OFFLINE=1 \
make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=de-DE
```

for online translation can remove `I18N_OFFLINE=1`. This command is written by default to the corresponding language pack under `v0.0.1`, `i18n.de-DE.up.sql`and the documentation. Migration only writes to non-empty fixed text, and existing values will not be overwritten. If the language pack has been manually completed, directly maintain `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`. Do not use this command to override the manual translation.

can also be edited on the internationalization maintenance page of the management end. The main language text with content in the form can be translated either individually or in batches in real time. The Draft interface only returns a single translation and does not write it into the unified internationalization table. Manual input will be directly saved to the unified internationalization table. After the empty text is successfully created or updated, it enters the asynchronous internationalization queue. When submitting an empty text, it will also be completed according to the saving logic. Failure messages will be scanned again by a scheduled task, and existing non-empty texts will not be overwritten. The internationalization interface is only available when `I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true`or equivalent application metadata is enabled. The system configuration name and values of text and rich text types support internationalization, while images and Boolean values are not sent out. Fall back to the main language when the runtime value is missing.

### 6. Verify and submit

recommends execution before submission:

```bash
make i18n-check
make i18n-sync
git diff --check

cd backend && go test ./...
cd ../frontend/admin && pnpm type:check && pnpm lint:oxlint
cd ../uni-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
cd ../taro-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
```

confirms that the new language is available in the following scenarios: first startup, language switch before login, switch after login, refresh and restore, dynamic menu, dictionary display, verification error, and main language fallback when dynamic translation is missing.

## No need to modify the content

New language does not need to be modified:

-Go locale constant, backend service registration and error localization code;
- Three-terminal locale runtime, module registration and request encapsulation;
- Proto, RPC generate file and menu routing code.

, read the compile-time language packs and the front-end registration files generated by the synchronization scripts. The runtime enabled language, default language, and sorting are provided by the `base_language`database records. Only when a new language reveals that the base library does not have a locale mapping, the language pack structure requires new fields, or the business indeed adds a new translation key, is it necessary to make corresponding dependency or code changes.

## Troubleshooting

: Phenomenon: Inspection
| --- | --- |
: `语言集合不一致`: Do all seven language pack directories have JSON with the same name
: `语言键集合不一致`: Compare the key and placeholder with `zh-CN.json`in the same directory
: `代码生成器语言键集合不一致`: Are the `system.code.gen.*`key and placeholder consistent in each backend language file
: `缺少组件语言映射`: Does Day.js/Element Plus provide files for this region or the base language
: The language can be switched but the name is empty. Check the record of `base_language`or add `common.language.<locale>`
: The menu/dictionary still shows the main language. Check if there are any non-empty records in the unified translation table and whether the request has been sent. `Accept-Language`

can be found in the final internationalization solution [国际化最终方案](国际化最终方案.md); the local constraints of the language pack directory can be found in the README of each directory.

documents.content:
# 安全策略与运维任务

## 登录安全

登录策略按全局、租户、用户作用域保存。每个作用域一条策略，策略下的黑白名单限制按规则逐条保存；只有匹配的启用策略才参与运行时判断，并按用户、租户、全局顺序覆盖失败锁定和密码有效期参数，同时叠加来源限制。没有任何匹配的启用策略时，不执行登录失败锁定、密码有效期和来源限制。

启用策略后，字段 `max_failed_attempts`、`lock_duration_minutes` 和 `password_max_age_days` 分别控制登录失败锁定和密码有效期；`password_max_age_days` 设置为 `0` 时不启用密码有效期。没有启用策略时，这些字段不生效。

MAC 限制匹配客户端提供的 `X-MAC-Address` 请求头，不能在普通 HTTP 中读取真实网卡 MAC；地区限制匹配受信任网关注入的 `X-Region-Code` 请求头，网关必须清理外部伪造值。

密码策略由 `BaseLoginPolicy` 的全局、租户和用户作用域配置，新增、重置和个人修改统一读取当前账号生效策略。密码复杂度按小写、大写、数字、符号四类字符计算。

密码策略字段如下：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `password_min_length` | `8` | 最小字符数 |
| `password_history_count` | `3` | 历史密码禁止重复的保留数量，`0` 表示不启用 |
| `password_min_complexity_classes` | `3` | 至少满足的小写、大写、数字、符号类别数量 |
| `password_max_age_days` | `90` | 密码有效期，`0` 表示不启用 |
| `initial_password` | 未配置 | 新增用户未提交密码时使用；该用户首次登录必须修改密码 |

## 当前会话

`BaseSessionService` 提供当前会话查看和撤销全部会话接口。登录时服务端记录会话创建时间、令牌签发时间、来源地址、设备和最后业务活动时间；管理 API 请求更新活动时间，刷新令牌请求不延长空闲时间。默认空闲超时为 30 分钟、绝对生命周期为 12 小时，由 `authn.session` 配置。

## 审计日志

Core 将请求和策略事件写入 `Core 日志事件流`，再由 Core 消费者分别落入 `base_api_log` 和 `base_policy_evaluation_log`；Admin 业务事件写入独立 `admin.log.event`，由 Admin 消费者落库。六张完整日志模型和自动迁移仍由 Admin 提供，六类日志全部异步入库，队列失败不在请求线程同步写库。普通租户不授予日志菜单和查询权限。

Admin 审计缓冲关闭/满、队列不可用或投递失败时，会根据隐藏系统配置 `auditLogSpool.file_path` 写入固定文件名 `admin-log.jsonl`，并执行文件同步；每条记录使用运行时密钥服务按 `kratos-admin:audit-log-spool/integrity` 派生密钥生成 HMAC。日志入库回退文件由 `system.admin.BaseLogFallback` 任务每日重新写入日志表，并应配置独立审计存储和告警。数据访问日志从真实 Proto 响应提取返回字段范围、记录条数和敏感字段触达标识；没有数据层事实时不伪造 SQL、表名或 SQL 指纹。

日志入库回退参数保存在隐藏系统配置 `auditLogSpool` 中，由系统配置服务统一维护并实时刷新缓存。配置结构如下：

```json
{
  "file_path": "./data/audit-log-spool"
}
```

启用定时任务 `system.admin.BaseTableArchive` 后，每天 03:30 读取 `base_table_archive` 中启用的表归档配置，按表将超过在线保留期的数据归档到当前数据源归档表或 OSS；只有归档校验成功且配置允许时才删除在线记录。普通应用日志的文件轮转和压缩由 `kratos-kit/logger` 负责。

## 数据库备份

数据库备份策略保存在 `base_table_backup` 中，数据库连接复用启动配置中的 `data.database` 或 `data.databases`；启用状态和保留数量均按数据源记录维护。每天 02:00 执行 `system.admin.BaseTableBackup`，备份完整性密钥和加密密钥分别按 `kratos-admin:backup/integrity`、`kratos-admin:backup/encryption` 从运行时密钥服务派生，不再通过服务进程环境变量注入：

`base_table_backup.status` 控制是否执行，`base_table_backup.retention_count` 控制保留数量；备份统一压缩、加密并上传 OSS。

任务会使用 AES-256 加密备份并上传 OSS，同时将 SHA-256、HMAC 和对象信息写入 `base_table_backup_record`；任务会回读 OSS 对象校验后才标记成功，恢复流程会拒绝缺少或校验失败的备份。备份和恢复均由服务程序控制，密钥不会通过服务进程环境变量注入，也不会出现在命令行参数中。

恢复统一通过管理端 `BaseTableBackupRestoreService.ExecuteBaseTableBackupRestore` 执行。程序会从 OSS 下载已校验的备份对象，完成完整性校验、解密、解压和导入；恢复前仍必须停止业务写入，并使用隔离环境完成恢复演练。

OAuth 客户端凭据使用独立的 `kratos-admin:oauth/credential-protection` 派生密钥加密存储；JWT 密钥轮换不会复用该密钥。
升级到该策略后，历史明文 OAuth 客户端需通过管理端“轮换客户端凭据”重新生成密钥，系统不再兼容旧明文凭据。

## 对象存储

文件服务复用 Core 的 OSS 适配器，支持 `local`、`aliyun`、`minio` 和 `s3`。单实例开发默认使用 `local`；多实例部署应切换到 MinIO/S3 兼容存储，并为每个租户配置独立路径前缀和最小权限凭据。Compose 中的 MinIO 使用 `object-storage` profile 启动。

上传入口限制文件数量、大小和扩展名，校验扩展名与服务端嗅探 MIME 一致，并拒绝 HTML、SVG、PHP、Flash 等可执行或可嵌入类型。生产环境可通过 `oss.upload_security` 配置 ClamAV 兼容扫描命令；若文件先进入外部隔离区并由网关扫描，可声明 `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_FILE_SCAN=true`，同时保留隔离、扫描结果和放行日志。

## 生产安全校验

独立服务以 `prod` 或 `production` 启动时会在数据库初始化前校验安全基线。外部能力声明包括：

| 变量 | 外部能力与必要证据 |
| --- | --- |
| `SECURITY_TLS_TERMINATED` | 反向代理或负载均衡 TLS 配置、证书和协议扫描结果 |
| `SECURITY_DATABASE_TLS_TERMINATED` | 数据库代理或服务网格链路加密配置 |
| `SECURITY_REDIS_TLS_TERMINATED` | Redis 代理或服务网格链路加密配置 |
| `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_BACKUP` | 备份策略、异地副本、恢复演练和 RPO/RTO 记录 |
| `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_LOG_ARCHIVE` | SIEM/WORM 留存策略、访问控制和完整性证据 |
| `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_FILE_SCAN` | 隔离区、恶意代码扫描策略和放行日志 |

未由外部平台承担时，应在 `base_table_archive`、`base_table_backup` 中配置归档与备份策略，在隐藏配置 `auditLogSpool` 中配置日志入库回退，并在 `oss.upload_security` 中配置扫描命令。生产校验只防止明显错误配置，不能替代等保测评、渗透测试和运维制度。

普通 HTTP API 默认请求体上限为 64 MiB、处理超时为 30 秒，统一由 `server.http.max_body_bytes` 和 `server.http.timeout` 配置。`/events`、`/mcp` 和 AI 消息流默认不设置请求超时，仅由 HTTP 请求体上限保护；文件上传还有独立的 20 MiB 单文件和 20 文件限制。

documents.content:
# Open License Design

open license is used for external development interfaces. It does not replace the user login on the management end, nor does it reuse the third-party login `OauthService`. The external development interface uses the `/api/v1/oauth/`path prefix. The management end maintains the client through `OauthClientService`.

only provides authorized client management and token issuance, and does not have an inbuilt `/api/v1/oauth/`business interface. The access party needs to contribute Proto, OpenAPI and services with this path prefix through an external Go module. When external business modules are not connected, the list of authorized apis on the management end is empty, and the client cannot use it to call business interfaces.

management page is located at `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/base/oauth-client`, where you can query authorization apis, create/edit/delete clients, start and stop clients, and copy full credentials. The complete credentials are only read on demand at the management end. `client_secret`and `crypto_key`do not enter the list response.

## Data model

only adds the `oauth_client`table:

- `client_id`, `client_secret`: Client credentials.
- `tenant_id`: The client binds to the tenant, and all client data and Token permissions use the data permissions of this tenant.
-`crypto_type`, `crypto_key`: The encrypted metadata of the caller protocol is read and decrypted by an open authorization HTTP Filter before the request binding.
-`ip_whitelist`: Comma-separated precise IP or CIDR.
-`api`: The JSON array of `base_api.operation`that is allowed to be accessed, without creating an associated table, and consistent with the menu API fields.
- `status`: Client start and stop status.

## Protocol process

1. The client submits `client_id`, `client_secret`and the optional `grant_type=client_credentials`to `POST /api/v1/base/oauth/client/token`.
2. Service verification credentials and client status, issue Bearer tokens using the existing JWT/Redis Token manager; The role code of the Token is `client_id`. `uid/rid`uses a negative client identity space to avoid conflicts with the user token cache key. When binding the default tenant, use the OAuth-specific tenant code to avoid bypassing data isolation by the cross-tenant management semantics of the default tenant.
3. When the management end creates or modifies a client, it converts the JSON API list into the Casbin operation policy of the client role under the default tenant.
4. The client carries the Bearer Token and calls the `/api/v1/oauth/`interface. HTTP OAuth middleware is executed only when the token role hits `oauth_client.client_id`, verifying the client's identity, status, source IP, and whether the current operation + HTTP method is in the API JSON whitelist respectively.
5. Ordinary user tokens will not hit the client table and will directly follow the existing user authentication and Casbin links.

## Data Encryption and decryption

client is created, the management end will generate a matching format `crypto_key`according to the algorithm:

: `crypto_type`: `crypto_key`format: Ciphertext format:
| --- | --- | --- |
: `sm4`:16-byte key encoded in Base64: Base64(`12 字节 nonce || ciphertext || 16 字节 GCM tag`)
: `aes`:32-byte key encoded in Base64: Base64(`12 字节 nonce || ciphertext || 16 字节 GCM tag`)

is as follows:

1. Call `POST /api/v1/base/oauth/client/token`, and use `client_id`and `client_secret`to obtain the Bearer Token.
2. For the requests of `POST`, `PUT`, and `PATCH`under `/api/v1/oauth/`, encrypt the normal JSON request body according to the client's algorithm and then encode it in Base64 Sent as the entire HTTP body; The query/path parameters of `GET`and `DELETE`remain in plaintext.
3. Requests must carry `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. The server first verifies the client Token, then reads the client algorithm and key, and decrypts before Proto HTTP body bind. Therefore, the business Service still receives the ordinary request object.
4. Successful 2xx responses will be encrypted. The current ProtoJSON direct response is encoded as Base64 ciphertext in the form of a JSON string. If the access party uses `{"code":200,"data":...}`to wrap the response, only the `data`field will be encrypted, while `code`and `msg`will remain in plaintext.
5.4xx /5xx error response is not encrypted to facilitate the location of credentials, IP, permissions or ciphertext format errors.

HTTP Filter is registered at `backend/internal/module/module.go`. The HTTP wrapper implementation is located at `backend/internal/server/middleware/oauth/crypto.go`, and the algorithm implementation is in its `crypto/`subdirectory. It is located on the outer layer of the generated Proto HTTP route; operation Service middleware cannot be used only because the request body has been bound when the latter is executed.

## boundary

API option, the save checksum, and the runtime interceptor will all reject interfaces that are not `/api/v1/oauth/`to prevent the management side, application side, or basic login interface from being authorized to the development client. After deactivating, modifying the whitelist or deleting the client, new requests are immediately affected. Delete and clean up the Casbin policy simultaneously.

client only needs to save the `client_id`, `client_secret`, `crypto_type`and `crypto_key`returned by the management end. Do not write `crypto_key`to the front-end repository or log. Updating the client algorithm will regenerate the key, and the old key will immediately become invalid. The client should re-read the credentials before initiating the call.

documents.content:
# Interface parameter verification

uses `buf.validate`to declare rules, and the Core's `server/middleware/validate.go`invokes protovalidate in HTTP and gRPC business processing. When the verification fails, return `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, and the response boundary localizes the first violated `message`according to the requested language. The error reason and metadata remain stable.

management end `ProForm`is used for real-time interactive prompts and cannot replace server-side verification. The constraints at both ends should express the same business rule. `rules`

## Proto writing style

```proto
import "buf/validate/validate.proto";
import "gnostic/openapi/v3/annotations.proto";

message ExampleForm {
  string name = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "名称"},
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.required"
      message: "请输入名称"
      expression: "this.size() > 0"
    },
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.max_len"
      message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符"
      expression: "this.size() <= 30"
    }
  ]; // 名称
}

message CreateExampleRequest {
  ExampleForm example = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "示例表单"},
    (buf.validate.field).required = true
  ]; // 示例表单
}
```

uses the stable `<resource>.<field>.<rule>`, and Chinese messages are directly directed to users. Don't rely on the default English error of the generator.

## Common Rules

Constraint Proto
| --- | --- |
: String required; CEL `this.size() > 0`:
; maximum length; CEL `this.size() <= 30`
positive number ID CEL `this > 0`
: Required for nested messages: `(buf.validate.field).required = true`
; enumeration legal; `(buf.validate.field).enum = {defined_only: true}`
; List not empty; CEL `this.size() > 0`
: List Unique; CEL `this.unique()`:
; email: `(buf.validate.field).string.email = true`
| URL | `(buf.validate.field).string.uri = true`|
regular expression: `(buf.validate.field).string.pattern = "..."`
set of values: `(buf.validate.field).string.in = ["a", "b"]`

cross-field rules are written at the message level:

```proto
message PeriodForm {
  option (buf.validate.message).cel = {
    id: "period.range"
    message: "结束时间不能早于开始时间"
    expression: "this.end_at >= this.start_at"
  };

  int64 start_at = 1 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "开始时间"}]; // 开始时间
  int64 end_at = 2 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "结束时间"}]; // 结束时间
}
```

, the existence of foreign keys, tenant permissions, protected resources, and state transitions depend on the database or the current identity. It must be placed in biz and cannot be disguised as format verification.

## ProForm

```ts
const fields: ProFormField[] = [
  {
    prop: "name",
    label: "名称",
    component: "input",
    props: { maxlength: 30, showWordLimit: true },
    rules: [
      { required: true, message: "请输入名称", trigger: "blur" },
      { max: 30, message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符", trigger: "blur" }
    ]
  }
];
```

- `required`, length, range, format and list quantity are provided with instant prompts on the front end.
Control restrictions such as
-`maxlength`, `min`, and `max`should be consistent with rules and Proto.
- The business verification message returned by the back end remains the final result. The front end must not skip error handling just because the form verification has been passed.
The
-`optional`field only executes the format rule when it has a value. The non-mandatory fields on the front end should not unconditionally add `required`.

## Change Check

1. Modify Proto comments, OpenAPI description, and `buf.validate`.
2. Execute `make -C backend api`and `make i18n-openapi`.
3. Execute `make -C frontend ts-admin`, `make -C frontend ts-uni-app`or `make -C frontend ts-taro-app`on the consumer end; Execute `make -C frontend ts`when three ends need to be generated at once.
4. Synchronize ProForm rules, control restrictions, and interface error displays.
5. Perform backend tests and corresponding front-end type checks.

are not modified manually.

# Database and Initialization data

## Current data source

uses the MySQL database `kratos_admin`. The basic configuration is located at `backend/configs/data.yaml`, and the difference in the development environment is at `backend/configs/data.dev.yaml`. Redis is used for caching states such as verification codes, one-time password keys, and tokens.

`data.database`indicates a single default data source; `data.databases`can declare multiple named data sources. The default data source saves the system table and the execution records of `base_migration`for all modules.

## Table creation and migration

is:

1. Create all GORM clients.
2. Execute the registration model of `AutoMigrate`for the client of `enable_migrate: true`.
3. Load module migration resources and execute `.up.sql`by dependency, version, database type, and data source.
4. Synchronize the existing multilingual descriptions in the migration directory to the unified translation table.
5. Complete the synchronization of OpenAPI interface data, tenant role menu and Casbin policy.

`enable_migrate`only controls GORM to automatically create tables and does not disable `v0.0.1`to initialize SQL. The new environment should enable it as the default data source; otherwise, tables like `base_migration`may not exist yet.

## Resource structure

Basic initialization resource directory:

```text
backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql/
├── README.md
├── README.en-US.md
├── README.ja-JP.md
├── README.zh-TW.md

The open license client uses GORM to automatically migrate and create the `oauth_client`table. built in and verified as `mysql`. The direct files in the database type directory belong to the `default`data source. The first-level subdirectory is the named data source and must be consistent with the configuration name. Scripts are executed in order of file names. `base_migration.description`only reads `README.md`in the same directory. If you need to connect to other database types, you still have to add the corresponding database type directory under `v0.0.1`. Do not add a new version directory.

`README.<locale>.md`synchronize to `base_i18n`with `base_migration.id`as the target ID and `I18N_TARGET_TYPE_BASE_MIGRATION_DESCRIPTION`as the target type. When language files exist, update the corresponding translation based on the file content. Do not add or modify the language record when it does not exist. The details interface prioritizes returning the translation of the requested language. If it is missing, it reverts `base_migration.description`.

, includes modules, data sources, and versions. If any upgrade script within a version fails, it will roll back that version and prevent the service from starting. After the repair and restart, it will retry the unrecorded version.

## Initialize the content

`default_data.up.sql`is provided together with the script of the same version language:

- Default tenant, department, position, role, and development accounts `super`and `admin`.
- System configuration, dictionary, menu, button and service method permission relationships.
- Management end System page, AI, code generation, API documentation and application end required permission entry.

`default_data.up.sql`is responsible for language logging, default business data, menus and permissions; The same version of `i18n.{locale}.up.sql`provides non-primary language translations of menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries, system configuration names/values, and scheduled task names through `base_i18n.target_type`. After the migration is completed, Core writes `README.<locale>.md`to `base_i18n`. The Admin details interface directly queries this table. The main language is configured by `base_language.is_primary`. The main table saves the text of the main language, while other enabled languages are saved to the unified translation table. The translation table and code generation `i18n_config`field is created by GORM `AutoMigrate`.

`base_area.up.sql`provides regional basic data. Initialize SQL using `INSERT IGNORE`. When encountering an existing unique key record, skip it and do not overwrite the existing data.

starts up, `BaseApiCase.InitializeOpenAPI`reconstructs the interface metadata based on the registered OpenAPI, then synchronizes the tenant administrator menu and reconstructs the Casbin rules. Therefore, when modifying the Proto path or the menu API list, it is necessary to simultaneously regenerate the OpenAPI and update the `v0.0.1`initialization SQL.

## New environment

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

, the default development account is:

- `super / 112233`
- `admin / 112233`

are only for local initialization and must be modified before deployment.

## Initialize the change

- All the initialization data, default data, menus, interface permissions and translations required for the table structure of the new features are uniformly completed to the full initialization state of `v0.0.1`.
- Directly modify the corresponding script and instructions under `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql`; No new `v0.0.2`or higher, also not increase the stock of incremental `.up.sql`/ `.down.sql`library.

# Log and Audit Design

> Status: Six types of queries, associated audits, asynchronous buffer warehousing, menu and archiving tasks have been implemented; Fault drills are continuously being improved.
> Date: 2026-08-31
> This design is incompatible with the old `base_log`query interface and does not migrate historical logs. When implementing, the brand-new initialization data of `v0.0.1`shall be taken directly as the standard.

## 1. Design Conclusion

is split into six independent tables. No public log parent table is established, and different facts are no longer mixed together through a single `log_type`field.

```text
base_login_log
base_api_log
base_operation_log
base_data_access_log
base_permission_log
base_policy_evaluation_log
```

records only one immutable fact:

Table: Answered questions: Typical producers
| --- | --- | --- |
: `base_login_log`: Who attempted authentication in what way and what was the result? Login, logout, token refresh, MFA, OAuth
: `base_api_log`: What happened with which protocol request? HTTP/gRPC unified access middleware
: `base_operation_log`: Who did what to which business object? Business Case or operation audit Interceptor
: `base_data_access_log`: Who accessed which data and what was the extent of the impact? Data access layer, export/download/query service
: `base_permission_log`: What changes have occurred in the permission configuration? Roles, menus, apis, and user permission services
: `base_policy_evaluation_log`: How does the authentication engine determine whether to allow or reject? Authentication engine decorators such as Casbin/OPA

`base_job_log`continues to exist as scheduled task execution logs, but it does not fall under category 6 security audits. The operation log file does not fall into these six tables either.

## 2. Common constraints

### 2.1 Events are immutable

- The audit table only appends and does not provide an editing interface.
- The management end only provides pagination, details and filtering, and does not offer new, modified or deleted buttons.
- Do not use `updated_at`; `created_at`indicates the time of database entry, and `occurred_at`indicates the time when the event occurred.
- After the retention period expires, it will be archived in the background or cleared in batches by time, and will not be deleted through the regular tenant API.
- Log write failure only records metrics and operation logs, and cannot change the original business request or authentication result.

### 2.2 Tenants and Entities

- `tenant_id`is used for association with the current business table, filtering, and data isolation.
-`tenant_code`must be retained simultaneously because the current Casbin uses tenant encoding as the policy domain.
-`user_id`, `user_name`, `role_id`, and `role_code`are snapshots at the time of the event's occurrence and cannot rely on subsequent associated tables to restore historical information.
- Login failure may prevent the user or tenant ID from being parsed. In such cases, the subject field is allowed to be empty, but the entered tenant code, account name, and client information should be saved.
- Regular tenants do not have log menu, query API, or detail API permissions; Only platform administrators can query cross-tenant records.

### 2.3 Sensitive data

prohibits the recording of passwords, access tokens, refresh tokens, private keys, CAPTcha answers, full cookies, and undesensitized request bodies.

- The request body and response body only retain desensitized summaries; Large fields are not stored in the database.
- Business snapshots only retain the fields that allow auditing. Fields such as passwords, tokens, keys, and verification codes are uniformly deleted or replaced with `[REDACTED]`.
- Policy input saves `input_hash`and the necessary desensitized digest, without saving complete user attributes, request headers, or SQL conditions.
- The SQL in the data access log can only save desensitized text and fingerprints. The strategy evaluation log does not save `scope_sql`.

## 3. Six-table structure

field type is based on MySQL, and the actual model is automatically migrated by GORM. This design does not add new table creation SQL.

### 3.1 `base_login_log`

authentication fact table records each key node of the authentication process, rather than just successful logins.

Field Type Description
| --- | --- | --- |
: `id`: `bigint`: Primary key
: `tenant_id`: `bigint NULL`: Tenant ID at the time of successful resolution
: `tenant_code`: `varchar(64)`: Tenant code in the request or token
: `user_id`: `bigint NULL`: Successfully parsed user ID:
: `user_name`: `varchar(128)`: Snapshot of account name
: `login_type`: `tinyint`: Password, OAuth, MFA, refresh token, logout
: `result`: `tinyint`: Success, Failure, Exception
: `reason_code`: `varchar(64)`: Classification of stability failure Causes
: `reason`: `varchar(500)`: Reasons after desensitization
: `client_ip`: `varchar(64)`: Client IP
| `user_agent`| `varchar(1024)`| User-Agent |
: `device_id`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Client device Identifier
: `request_id`: `varchar(64) NULL`: Request ID:
: `trace_id`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Trace ID:
: `occurred_at`: `datetime(3)`: Authentication event time
: `created_at`: `datetime(3)`: Log entry time

Index:

- `idx_base_login_log_tenant_occurred_at (tenant_id, occurred_at)`
- `idx_base_login_log_user_occurred_at (tenant_id, user_id, occurred_at)`
- `idx_base_login_log_result_occurred_at (tenant_id, result, occurred_at)`
- `idx_base_login_log_ip_occurred_at (client_ip, occurred_at)`
-`idx_base_login_log_request_id (request_id)`, `idx_base_login_log_trace_id (trace_id)`

### 3.2 `base_api_log`

protocol accesses the fact table. It records the technical results of requests and does not infer whether business actions have actually occurred.

Field Type Description
| --- | --- | --- |
: `id`: `bigint`: Primary key
: `tenant_id`: `bigint NULL`: Current tenant ID:

; `reason_code`; `varchar(64) NULL`; Classification of stability failure causes

### 3.3 `base_operation_log`

business operation fact table is written only when actions such as adding, modifying, deleting, publishing, and withdrawing with clear business semantics occur.

Field Type Description
| --- | --- | --- |
: `id`: `bigint`: Primary key
: `tenant_id`: `bigint`: Tenant ID:
: `tenant_code`: `varchar(64)`: Tenant Code snapshot
: `user_id`: `bigint NULL`: Operator User ID
: `user_name`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Snapshot of Operator Name
: `request_id`: `varchar(64) NULL`: Request ID
: `trace_id`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Trace ID:
; `resource_type`; `varchar(128)`; resource type, such as `base_user`
: `resource_id`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Resource ID:
: `resource_name`: `varchar(255) NULL`: Snapshot of resource name
: `action`: `tinyint`: Add, modify, delete, publish, withdraw, etc
: `changed_fields`: `json NULL`: Field Change List
: `before_data`: `json NULL`: Snapshot before the change after desensitization
: `after_data`: `json NULL`: desensitized updated snapshot
: `result`: `tinyint`: Success, Failure, Exception
: `reason_code`: `varchar(64) NULL`: Classification of stability reasons
: `reason`: `varchar(500) NULL`: Reasons after desensitization
: `occurred_at`: `datetime(3)`: Time of action occurrence
: `created_at`: `datetime(3)`: Log entry time

Index:

- `idx_base_operation_log_resource (tenant_id, resource_type, resource_id, occurred_at)`

- `idx_base_operation_log_action_occurred_at (tenant_id, action, occurred_at)`
-`idx_base_operation_log_request_id (request_id)`, `idx_base_operation_log_trace_id (trace_id)`

### 3.4 `base_data_access_log`

data access fact table is strictly distinguished from the business operation table. Queries, details, exports, downloads, and imports can all generate access records, but this does not mean that the data has been modified.

Field Type Description
| --- | --- | --- |
: `id`: `bigint`: Primary key
: `tenant_id`: `bigint`: Tenant ID:
: `tenant_code`: `varchar(64)`: Tenant Code snapshot
: `user_id`: `bigint NULL`: Operator User ID
: `user_name`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Snapshot of Operator Name
: `request_id`: `varchar(64) NULL`: Request ID
: `trace_id`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Trace ID:
: `resource_type`: `varchar(128)`: Business Resource type
Resource ids for scenarios such as details and downloads:
; `resource_id`; `varchar(128) NULL`
: `access_type`: `tinyint`: List, Details, Export, Download, Import, Query
: `data_source`: `varchar(64)`: Data source name
: `table_name`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Data table name
: `field_scope`: `json NULL`: Access field range, no field value saved
: `data_scope`: `varchar(128) NULL`: Data range identifier

## 5. Event write responsibility

```text

协议请求中间件         -> base_api_log
业务 Case              -> base_operation_log

### 5.1 Request Link

The same request can generate multiple different facts, but each one is only written to the table to which it belongs

```text
请求进入
  -> base_api_log
  -> base_policy_evaluation_log
  -> base_data_access_log（实际访问数据时）
  -> base_operation_log（实际发生业务变更时）
```

### 5.2 Granularity of Strategy Evaluation Records

- `IsAuthorized`generates one record each time the actual engine is called.
- Multi-tenant or multi-agent cycle assesses tenant/agent records based on actual conditions, retaining the same `request_id`and `trace_id`.
-`FilterAuthorizedPairs`, `FilterAuthorizedProjects`record the aggregation results and do not write separate lines for each candidate.
- Each real `IsAuthorized`engine call is recorded. The time consumption only covers the engine call and does not include subsequent business processing.
- Writes use asynchronous buffering or batch queues, and log failures cannot cause authentication to fail.

### 5.3 Core Audit Event Handling (Completed)

The facts of API and policy evaluation are collected, delivered and asynchronously entered into the library by Core. When the queue is unavailable, record the delivery error and do not roll back to the deleted old table.

Only consumers of `Core 日志事件流`and `admin.log.event`can invoke the log Repository. Consumers map the stable queue message numbers to the log primary key. When the same message is reinvested after a successful write to the library but a failed ACK, it is treated as existing. When the buffer is full, the queue is unavailable, or event serialization fails, only the running log is recorded. Blocking requests or synchronously reverting to the write library is not allowed.

## 6.The boundaries of responsibilities between Core and Admin

### 6.1 `kratos-core`is responsible

- Defines the universal `LogEvent`, event type, desensitized context, and `LogEmitter/LogSink`interface.
- Collects API request facts at the HTTP/gRPC transport layer.
- Collecting authentication allow/deny and policy evaluation within the authorization middleware is time-consuming. The rejection result must be collected before the middleware returns in advance. The login result is recorded by the Admin business middleware.
- Deliver and consume `Core 日志事件流`via `Core 日志流水线`, and write `base_api_log`and `base_policy_evaluation_log`using a streamlined internal model.
- Remove the hard coding of `models.BaseLog`by `logging.Server`and eliminate the mandatory dependency of the queue service on `BaseLogRepository`.

Core does not rely on Admin business models such as `base_login_log`and `base_permission_log`, nor does it provide a log menu or a management page.

### 6.2 `kratos-admin`is responsible

- Defines the complete GORM model of six `base_*_log`tables, and is uniformly responsible for model registration, automatic migration, and querying the Repository.
- Deliver and consume `admin.log.event`, asynchronously write login, operation, data access and permission logs.
- Provides six sets of read-only Protos, query services, management end pages, menus, and administrator permissions.
- Retain `base_job_log`as the Core task execution log; It does not belong to the sixth category of security audits.

### 6.3 Target data stream

```text
Core HTTP/gRPC 与认证/授权采集
  -> Core Core 日志流水线 进程内缓冲
Core Core 日志流水线 后台工作协程
  -> Core 日志事件流

Admin LogSink 后台工作协程
  -> admin.log.event
  -> Admin 登录/操作/数据访问/权限日志 Repository
```

### 6.4 Cross-repository implementation sequence

1. Add `Core 日志流水线`to `kratos-core`, which is responsible for queue delivery and asynchronous warehousing of API/ policy events, and remove the old `base_log`queue contract and warehouse.
2.Admin registers six complete models and is responsible for automatic migration; The Admin itself registers the `admin.log.event`consumer and asynchronously writes the other four types of logs.
3.Admin deletes `BaseLogService`, `BaseLogCase`, the local `base_log`model /Repository, old pages and menus; Change the pronunciation of `OpsMonitoring`to `base_api_log`.
4. In the Admin's `v0.0.1`, six types of menus and permission initialization are retained, and no incremental or table creation SQL is added.
5. Completed the generation, testing and Redis/MySQL integration of Core and Admin.

## 7. Proto, service and management end
