# Service Access Guide

This article explains how to integrate a new capability into the current Backend, management end, or application end. Only describe the expansion methods that the warehouse has adopted.

## First, determine the ownership

: Scene: Back-end Proto: Back-end implementation: Front-end
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
: Shared by admin, uni-app and Taro; `api/proto/base/v1`: `biz/base`, `service/base/v1`: Three-terminal on-demand generation and encapsulation
: MFA Certification: `api/proto/base/v1/mfa.proto`: `biz/base/mfa.go`, `service/base/v1`: Login Process, Management end and application end Personal Center
: Open Authorization Client: `api/proto/base/v1/oauth_client.proto`, `api/proto/system/admin/v1/oauth_client.proto`: `biz/base/oauth_client.go`, `biz/system/admin/oauth_client.go`: Management end configuration, external client invocation
System Management: `api/proto/system/admin/v1`: `biz/system/admin`, `service/system/admin/v1`: System Module
: Backend Workbench and File Assets: `api/proto/system/admin/v1/base_dashboard.proto`, `base_file.proto`, `biz/system/admin/base_dashboard.go`, `base_file.go`: System Module
: Application System Capabilities `api/proto/system/app/v1`: `biz/system/app`, `service/system/app/v1`: uni-app and Taro
: Independent business Module: Module's own Proto; Module's own implementation; Independent management end, uni-app or Taro host module

uses the existing Base boundary: `BaseLoginPolicyService`manages the platform login source policy, and `BaseSessionService`manages the current session. Core generates API, authentication, and policy events, which are delivered to `Core 日志事件流`through its own `Core 日志流水线`and asynchronously written to the API/ policy log. Admin business events are asynchronously entered into the database by Admin itself through the independent `admin.log.event`queue. The six complete log models and automatic migration are still provided by Admin. The request middleware must not synchronously roll back to the write library.

general-purpose type prioritizes the reuse of `common.v1`in Buf; System cross-end enumeration of `system/common/v1`.

## Built-in backend capabilities

1. When there are changes in the table structure, update the development library first, and then run `make -C backend gorm-gen`.
2. Define Proto, HTTP mapping, OpenAPI description and `buf.validate`.
3. Run `make -C backend api`and `make i18n-openapi`, and run `make -C frontend ts-admin`, `make -C frontend ts-uni-app`or `make -C frontend ts-taro-app`on the consumer side. Run `make -C frontend ts`when generating three ends at once.
4. Implement the business at `internal/biz/<module>`in the root directory of the corresponding Proto module, and implement the Proto service at `internal/service/<module>/v1`in the retained version directory. For example, `system/admin/v1`corresponds to `biz/system/admin`and `service/system/admin/v1`.
5. Add the service to the corresponding `internal/server/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}/register.go`.
After the ProviderSet or constructor parameter changes, update `backend/internal/module/wire.go`or `backend/internal/cmd/server/wire.go`, and run `make -C backend public-wire`or `make -C backend wire`respectively.
Directly complete the default data, menu, button and service method permissions in the unique `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql`initialization migration without adding a new migration version or incremental patches.
8. If new user-visible copy is added, synchronize the language pack of the corresponding module and execute `make i18n-sync`.

includes `api/gen/go`, `internal/data/gen`, `internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml`, the management end, uni-app, and the Taro package `src/rpc`and `wire_gen.go`. Manual editing is not allowed.

## External Go module

provides static resources that must be collected before business construction through `module.Resources`:

```go
func NewModuleResources() module.Resources {
	return module.Resources{
		ProjectKey:  "order",
		ProjectName: "订单",
		Models:      orderdata.Models(),
		OpenAPI:     orderopenapi.Assets(),
		Docs:        orderdocs.Assets(),
```

Core will first initialize the database, cache, queue and other infrastructure based on static resources. Subsequently, Wire builds the modules Case and Service, and the complete module implements protocol registration and runtime contribution:

```go
type Module struct {
	service orderv1.OrderServiceHTTPServer
}

func (m *Module) RegisterHTTP(server *http.Server) {
	orderv1.RegisterOrderServiceHTTPServer(server, m.service)
}

func (m *Module) registerAI(registrar module.AIRegistrar) error {
	return registrar.RegisterTools(module.AITerminalAdmin, m.agentTools...)
}

func (m *Module) Contributions() module.Contributions {
	return module.Contributions{
		AI: m.registerAI,
		/* Tasks、SSE、StartupHooks */
	}
}
```

composite root uses `kratoscore.ProviderSet`, `kratoscore.BusinessProviderSet`, `NewModuleResources`and the module business Provider. Core provides BaseCase, Job, SSE, OpenAPI and Docs capabilities through the publicly available types `biz`, `biz/dto`, `config`and `module`. The `internal`directory only retains the implementation details of Core.

only use the generation of gRPC Client. Within the process, `Runtime.ClientConn()`can be used, and a standard gRPC connection can be used remotely. The calling code does not depend on the Backend `internal`.

```ts
const views = import.meta.glob<{ default: Component }>("./views/**/*.vue");
```

## Application host

The request is placed in the `src/api`of the affiliated package. The business type comes from the generated `src/rpc`, and the page does not directly call `uni.request`.

# Login and password encryption

This article records the current shared account passwords, verification codes, OAuth, MFA, password ciphertext and Token mechanism among the management end, uni-app and Taro. The interface is based on `backend/api/proto/base/v1/login.proto`, `oauth.proto`, and `mfa.proto`.

## account and password

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant UI as 前端
  participant API as Backend
  participant Cache as Redis
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/config
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/captcha
  UI->>API: POST /api/v1/base/captcha/verify（行为验证码）
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/password-public-key?scene=LOGIN
  API->>Cache: 保存一次性私钥，TTL 5 分钟
  UI->>UI: RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM 加密密码
  UI->>API: POST /api/v1/base/session
  API->>Cache: 消费验证码和一次性私钥
  API-->>UI: access_token / refresh_token / expires_in
  UI->>API: GET 当前端 profile
```

is not transmitted, the default tenant is used at the back end. Search for the account by pressing `tenant_code + user_name`. Currently, there is no branch logged in with the independent `phone`field.

directly submits `captcha_id`and the user's answer. The slider, click, rotate and other behavior verification codes first call `/api/v1/base/captcha/verify`to obtain a one-time `captcha_token`with a validity period of 2 minutes, and then submit the token as the login `captcha_code`.

## Cryptographic protocol

算法标识：

```text
RSA-OAEP-256+A256GCM
```

1. The front end requests a one-time RSA public key for the specified scenario.
2. The front end executes `trim()`on the password to generate a 32-byte AES-256 key and a 12-byte GCM IV.
3. Aes-gcm encryption password, RSA-OAEP(SHA-256) encryption AES key.
After Base64 encoding, submit `key_id`, `nonce`, `algorithm`, `encrypted_key`, `iv`, and `ciphertext`.
5. The backend verifies the scene, nonce and algorithm, reads the private key from Redis and immediately deletes it, and then decrypts it with `go-utils/crypto.Verify`to compare the database password hash.

has a TTL of 5 minutes and is deleted immediately after reading. The same ciphertext cannot be replayed. If a retry fails, the public key must be retrieved again and encrypted.

management end and the two application ends uses Web Crypto. uni-app and Taro wechat mini-program use the static import of `asmcrypto.js`, `wx.getRandomValues`and wechat Base64 API on their respective bases to avoid dynamic import compatibility issues in the mini-program environment.

## wechat Mini Program OAuth

application `MP-WEIXIN`uses provider `wechatmini`:

1.`wx.login()`obtain the one-time code and submit `/api/v1/base/oauth/session`.
2. When bound, the backend returns the authentication result according to the MFA policy; Allow automatic registration. When not bound, create a user first and continue with authentication.
3. When unbound and automatic registration is not allowed, return `binding_required=true`, and the page displays the tenant, username, password and digital verification code.
4. When the user submits the binding form, they must re-call `wx.login()`and then request `/api/v1/base/oauth/binding/session`. The back end first verifies the verification code, account password and new code, and then writes the binding within the transaction and generates the login authentication status. Repeated submission of the same user and the same wechat ID is idempotent. If it has already been bound by another user, it will be rejected.

can only be used once. The same code cannot be reused for detecting the binding status and formal binding.

binding interface continues to follow `LoginStatus`and will not directly skip MFA just because "a binding relationship has been written"

- `AUTHENTICATED`: Save the access/refresh token, load the profile, and enter the original target page.
- `MFA_REQUIRED`: No temporary token is saved. Call `/api/v1/base/mfa/verify`using TOTP, WebAuthn or recovery code. After successful verification, save the official token and enter the original target page.
-`MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED`: No official token is issued. Use `mfa_setup_ticket`to call `/api/v1/base/mfa/enrollment`to obtain the binding parameters, and then call `/api/v1/base/mfa/enrollment/confirm`to complete the factor binding and only display the recovery code once. The wechat Mini Program then goes through `wx.login()`again to enter `MFA_REQUIRED`. Only after the user completes the factor verification can the login be considered complete.

If the binding request returns an error, the binding relationship will not be stored in the database. After repairing the verification code, password or MFA configuration in this way, it can be safely retried without being blocked by the remaining "wechat account bound" status.

management end also supports OAuth provider list, authorization jump, callback, binding list and unbinding; The specific provider is configured by `backend/configs/oauth*.yaml`.

## Token

includes `token_type`, `access_token`, `refresh_token`and `expires_in`. The HTTP request simultaneously sets the `kratos_refresh_token`HttpOnly Cookie and the `kratos_refresh_exp`expiration prompt Cookie that does not contain sensitive information. The management end only persists access tokens and user information, and prioritizes the use of cookies when refreshing. uni-app/Taro can still read the refresh token in the response body and should switch to platform secure storage.

calls `POST /api/v1/base/token`when the access token has no more than 5 minutes remaining and concurrently refreshes to share the same Promise. The request body can omit `refresh_token`, and the server will read and rotate the refresh token from the HttpOnly Cookie. A failed refresh will clean up the local login state. Logging out will delete the access/refresh token, Cookie and the cache authentication information corresponding to the refresh token.

management end disables, deletes the user, resets the password or adjusts the user role relationship, the back end will revoke the user's existing access/refresh token to prevent the old authentication payload from continuing to access.

background are uniformly verified against the currently effective `BaseLoginPolicy`. When creating a user who has not submitted a password, the backend uses the initialization password hash in the matching policy. The login response for this user is `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`. The password must be changed first. The initialization password is only saved in hash form, and the policy details will not return the original value.

uses `authMode: "none"`or an equivalent configuration, without carrying the old `Authorization`. Requests for login will automatically add tokens.

## Multi-factor authentication

System configuration for the management and application ends `securityMfaMethod`Select `totp`or `webauthn`For `securityMfaPolicy`, choose `disabled`, `optional`or `all_required`. Runtime parameters are loaded through the `mfa`node of `backend/configs/mfa.yaml`or `mfa.dev.yaml`, where the TOTP binding must be configured with `encryption_key`(a 32-byte key encoded in base64). TOTP uses an Authenticator dynamic password and a one-time recovery code. When disabled, it verifies the current password and the dynamic password or recovery code. WebAuthn uses the browser's Passkey or security key to complete the registration and login of ceremony. When disabled, it verifies the current password and a Passkey or recovery code. The server saves the short-term challenge in Redis And save the creditable public key and signature counter in `base_user_mfa_webauthn`. The production environment should manage this configuration through KMS, Vault or Secret Manager and maintain the same encryption key upon restart.

take effect at a stricter value to prevent the security requirements of the administrator or the application end from being lowered through the forgeable `source-client`request header. The semantics of `disabled`, `optional`and `all_required`are respectively: no MFA is required, binding is optional and verification is required upon login, and unbound users must enter the binding process after logging in. When wechat Mini Programs do not support WebAuthn, bound users can log in with a one-time recovery code. WebAuthn binding needs to be completed on a client that supports Passkey. Enabling or disabling MFA will undo the user's existing sessions. The TOTP recovery code is displayed only once after generation.

## Key entry

: Field: Path
| --- | --- |
log in to Proto: `backend/api/proto/base/v1/login.proto`
| OAuth Proto | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/oauth.proto`|
| MFA Proto | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/mfa.proto`|
: Backend login: `backend/internal/biz/base/login.go`
; backend OAuth; `backend/internal/biz/base/oauth.go`
; Backend MFA; `backend/internal/biz/base/mfa.go`; `backend/internal/service/base/v1/mfa_service.go`
Key Generation and decryption `backend/internal/biz/base/utils/password_crypto.go`
: Management end password encryption: `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts`
: Management end WebAuthn: `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/utils/webauthn.ts`, `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/profile/components/security.vue`
: uni-app login and password encryption: `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/views/pages/login/login.vue`, `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts`
| uni-app WebAuthn | `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/utils/webauthn.ts`|
: Taro login and password encryption: `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/views/pages/login/login.tsx`, `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts`
| Taro WebAuthn | `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/utils/webauthn.ts`|
: Application Token and request: `packages/core/src/utils/auth.ts`, `http.ts`for each of the two applications

checks the configuration, verification code, public key, ciphertext scenario, login response, Token saving and profile request in sequence when the login fails. Do not record plaintext passwords, private keys, full tokens or verification code answers in logs or documents.

# kratos-admin Design of the in-site messaging and notification center

Status: Design and implementation record. The current function has been integrated.
> ** Facts ** are from the current source code or external first-hand materials; The "suggestion" is about the selection and rejection of this project.
> This article records the design boundaries, implementation status, and acceptance key points, and does not replace the project's generation chain and `v0.0.1`initialization migration.

## 1. Scope and Conclusion

should be "database inbox + asynchronous audience expansion + SSE's best effort to wake up", not a chat system, and SSE delivery cannot be regarded as business success.

```text
管理员/业务发布
  -> MySQL: Message + Dispatch 同事务
  -> Redis Streams: 仅投递 dispatch_id
  -> Consumer: 分批解析受众、幂等写 Delivery
  -> SSE: 通知在线客户端 inbox.changed
  -> Client: 回查 Summary/Page，MySQL 为最终事实
```

核心决策：

1. Four new business tables of `Category/Message/Dispatch/Delivery`have been added.
2. Dispatch simultaneously undertakes the audience rules, Transactional Outbox, execution lease, and fan-out cursor.
3. Delivery uses `read_at/revoked_at/archived_at/deleted_at`to express orthogonal states instead of a single SENT/READ state.
4. Classification uses independent tables to carry display information and notification policies; The category name, title and body text should not be written in `base_i18n`.
5. User API set `base.v1.NotificationService`; Manage the API for `system.admin.v1.BaseMessageService`and `BaseMessageCategoryService`.
6. Business release via `pkg/notification.Publisher`; Business operations are not allowed to directly double write to the database and Redis.
7. Use the current Redis Streams Queue and do not introduce Asynq.
8.Admin /H5 uses a shared SSE; The first phase of wechat Mini Programs will use onShow refresh and short polling.

includes administrator drafts, scheduled/immediate release, retraction, and delivery progress. Designate all users, roles, departments, positions, and tenants; User pagination, details, read/unread, All Read, archived and personal hidden; Three-terminal unread and real-time refresh.

does not include private chat/group chat, input status, delivery receipt, external email and SMS channels, user notification preferences, any HTML/ script, precise one-time commitment, and cross-tenant message sharing.

business module only constructs `notification.Message`and invokes `notification.Publish`. The publishing end uses tenant, source and idempotent key plagiarism checking, mandatorily requires at least one audience and verifies the text format. Once the database is successfully submitted, it is regarded as a successful publication. If the queue wake-up fails, the recovery task will make up for it.

## 2. External research conclusion

### 2.1 Redis Streams

** Fact ** : `XREADGROUP`places the delivered but unconfirmed message into PEL. After successful processing, `XACK`is required; Timeout messages can be claimed. `XAUTOCLAIM`is equivalent to an automated PEL scan and claim. `XADD MAXLEN ~`will approximately trim old entries and cannot guarantee that unconfirmed loads will never be lost.

来源：

- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xreadgroup/>
- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xack/>
- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xautoclaim/>
- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xadd/>

** Suggestion: **Queue only stores location information; Dispatch must be capable of rebuilding tasks after Stream messages are lost, duplicated, or trimmed. The handler only returns nil after a database batch is successful.

### 2.2 Outbox and idempotence

** Fact ** : AWS Transactional Outbox uses the same transaction to write business data and Outbox, and then forwards them in the background, solving the problem of double writing to the database and broker. Its documentation clearly requires consumers to handle repetition and pay attention to the sequence. Azure also recommends atomically saving objects and events, background relays, and absorbing reprocessing with stable message ids/idempotent consumption.

来源：

- <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/transactional-outbox.html>
- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/databases/guide/transactional-out-box-cosmos>
- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/idempotent-consumer>

** Suggestion: **Message and Dispatch are the same transaction; Publish the API and return "PUBLISHING" without waiting for the major broadcast to complete. The unique index absorbs the Queue for reinvestment.

### 2.3 Peak shaving and real-time connection

** fact: **Azure Queue-Based Load Leveling uses queues to smooth bursts; Competing Consumers process independent messages in parallel with multiple consumers, but they are idempotent and take order into account.

来源：

- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/queue-based-load-leveling>
- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/competing-consumers>

** Fact ** : WHATWG SSE defines auto-reconnection, `id/retry/Last-Event-ID`; The MDN description comments can be kept alive, and the number of HTTP/1 same-origin connections is very low, making it suitable for reusing single connections.

来源：

- <https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html>
- <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events>

** Suggestion: **SSE only sends change signals; After reconnection, always check the Summary/Page. Last-Event-ID is only used for short-term optimization.

### 2.4 Inbox, Security and Three-Terminal

** Fact ** : GitHub separates Read, Done, Save, and Unsubscribe, and supports filtering/grouping; GitLab's To-Do supports Done, Undo, Snooze, batch processing, and removes the To-Do when resource access rights disappear.

来源：

- <https://docs.github.com/en/subscriptions-and-notifications/how-tos/viewing-and-triaging-notifications/managing-notifications-from-your-inbox>
- <https://docs.gitlab.com/user/todos/>

** Suggestion: ** Separate read from archive; The first issue of archive expresses Done; Re-verify the target resource permissions when clicking the notification action.

** Fact ** : OWASP suggests that the tenant context comes from the authentication session, the query uses tenant_id + resource_id, and the cache key carries the tenant; Untrusted content should be prioritized for encoding output. Only when HTML is truly necessary should sanitization be performed.

来源：

- <https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Multi_Tenant_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html>
- <https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Cross_Site_Scripting_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html>

** Fact ** : wechat `wx.request`collects chunks through `enableChunked/onChunkReceived`, not a browser EventSource; Taro and uni-app also mark enableChunked as a wechat Mini Program capability.

来源：

- <https://developers.weixin.qq.com/miniprogram/dev/api/network/request/wx.request.html>
- <https://docs.taro.zone/docs/apis/network/request/>
- <https://uniapp.dcloud.net.cn/api/request/request.html>

** Suggestion: ** The AI active stream continues to chunked; The first phase of the in-site message mini-program does not maintain the full director request. The H5 conditional branch uses fetch SSE.

## 3. Local status quo

- `backend/bootstrap.go`has exposed QueueConsumers and Streams; Admin has registered the `base.message.dispatch`consumer and recovery task.
-Dispatch establishes a 5-minute database lease between `lock_token`and `locked_until`. Claim, progress write-back, and failure write-back all verify the lease token. Recovery tasks only re-queue waiting, pending processing, and expired running tasks.
- `data.redis`When not empty, `kratos-kit/queue.NewQueue`actually selects Redis Streams, even if the memory queue exists simultaneously as configured.
- Currently, the default Redis consumer group is `redisqueue`, and the default hostname of the consumer; visibility 60 seconds, reclaim 1 second, concurrency 10.
- Locally implement recycling with `XPENDING + XCLAIM`. After success, `XACK + XDEL`.
- When the producer is not explicitly configured, the StreamMaxLength defaults to 1000 and is approximately trimmed. Large broadcasts cannot rely on it to save all to-do items.
-`kratos-core/data.Transaction`can now enable multiple Repo to share transactions through context.
-`base_user`has tenant/role/dept/post; The message body is saved in `base_message.content`.
-Admin already has `fetch-event-source`with Authorization, Accept Language and shared connection.
-uni-app /Taro's AI: H5 Fetch SSE, wechat Mini Program chunked; There is no global notification flow yet.
Both SSE entry points of
-Core hard reject `user/authuser`: Independent resolver and `SSE.Serve`.
- Currently, `SSEStream.Resolve(channelID,userID)`is missing tenant/role/ full Principal.
-transport supports Last-Event-ID/Event.ID, but Core `PublishJSON`does not set an ID. replay is only within the process and has a TTL of 300 seconds.

## 4. Domain Model and Four Tables

### 4.1 `base_message_category`

platform has a unified message classification maintained by the default tenant administrator. The message body and receipt records are still isolated by tenant:

: Field Group: Suggested
| --- | --- |
Identifier: id, code
display: name, icon, color, sort
: Default Policies: default_priority, retention_days, allow_archive, allow_delete
: Lifecycle: status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

约束与索引：

- `unique(code)`;" `code`is a stable identifier used for business release and does not change with its name.
- `(status,sort,id)`.
- the default classification suggests the SYSTEM/SECURITY/TASK/BUSINESS; Do not copy classified rows for each tenant, nor use `tenant_id=0`pseudo-shared rows.
- Disabling only blocks the use of new messages and does not affect historical messages; When there is already a Message reference, deletion is prohibited; only disabling is allowed.
-`retention_days=0`indicates the adoption of the system's default retention period. Security classification can prohibit personal archiving or deletion.

### 4.2 `base_message`

logical message and frozen content:

: Field Group: Suggested
| --- | --- |
: Attribution: id, tenant_id, source_type, source, idempotency_key, payload_hash
: Sender: sender_type, sender_id, sender_name
: content:, priority, title, content, content_format
: action: action_type, action_target, action_params JSON
life cycle: status, scheduled_at, published_at, revoked_at, expires_at
progress: recipient_total, delivered_total, failed_total
: Concurrency/audit: version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at

约束与索引：

- `unique(tenant_id,source,idempotency_key)`.
- `(tenant_id,category_id,status,created_at,id)`.
- `(tenant_id,status,created_at,id)`, `(status,scheduled_at,id)`, `(status,expires_at,id)`.
-DRAFT is required for editing. After entering PUBLISHING, the content and audience are frozen.
- Verification platform classification is enabled at the time of release; Message saves, history display unaffected by subsequent disabling of the category, message and recipient records continue to verify tenant_id.
- Main language title/body required; The action is not an authorization certificate.

### 4.3 `base_message_dispatch`

Audience rules + Outbox + fan-out cursor:

: Field Group: Suggested
| --- | --- |
: Attribution: id, tenant_id, message_id
: Audience: audience_type, audience_id, include_children
: Execute status, cursor_user_id, batch_size
count: matched_total, inserted_total
try attempt_count, next_retry_at, last_error
lease: lock_token, locked_until, version
observation: queued_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at

on support USER/ROLE/DEPT/POST/TENANT; All Selectors must be tenant with the Message, and for multiple Selectors, the union is taken.

Index:

- `unique(message_id,audience_type,audience_id,include_children)`.
- `(status,next_retry_at,locked_until,id)`.
- `(tenant_id,message_id,status)`.

### 4.4 `base_message_delivery`

用户收件事实：

-id, tenant_id, message_id, user_id, received_at, expires_at.
-read_at, archived_at, revoked_at, deleted_at.
-created_at, updated_at.

Index:

- `unique(tenant_id,message_id,user_id)`.
- `(tenant_id,user_id,archived_at,deleted_at,id)`.
- `(tenant_id,user_id,read_at,revoked_at,deleted_at,id)`.
-`(tenant_id,message_id,id)`.

state:

```text
visible = deleted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now)
unread  = visible AND read_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL
```

### 4.5 Classification and Content Format

- The category name is saved in `base_message_category.name`, and the icon and color are uniformly provided by the category table.
-Message saves the main text of the title and body. Do not write the message category, title, or body to `base_i18n`.
-`base_i18n`continues to only carry dynamic resources such as existing system configurations, dictionaries, menus, tasks, and migration instructions.
- The main text supports PLAIN_TEXT, SAFE_MARKDOWN and RICH_TEXT; RICH_TEXT only allows whitelist HTML generated by the editor and must be cleaned before display.

## 5. State Machine

```text
Message:
DRAFT -> SCHEDULED -> PUBLISHING -> PUBLISHED -> REVOKED/ARCHIVED
DRAFT ----------publish----------> PUBLISHING
SCHEDULED --cancel--> DRAFT
PUBLISHING --revoke--> REVOKED

Dispatch:
WAITING -> PENDING -> RUNNING -> PENDING(下一批) -> SUCCEEDED
RUNNING -> PENDING(next_retry_at) / FAILED
WAITING/PENDING/RUNNING -> CANCELLED
FAILED -> PENDING(人工重试)
```

-PUBLISHING stated that the reliable to-do list has been submitted but the audience has not fully expanded.
"
-PUBLISHED" indicates that all dispatches were successful and does not mean that the user received online.
- When partial Dispatch fails, the Message remains published and displays the progress of the failure.
- REVOKED update Delivery.revoked_at in the same transaction by message_id to ensure that queries and unreads are immediately excluded; If the stress test proves that the large broadcast batch update lock holding is unacceptable, then introduce REVOKING and batch convergence states.

## 6. Proto and release interface draft

### 6.1 `base.v1.NotificationService`

unified prefix `/api/v1/base/notification`:

- `PageInbox`: GET, cursor pagination; The view INBOX/UNREAD/ARCHIVED can be filtered by category/priority.
- `GetNotification`: GET `/{delivery_id}`.
- `GetInboxSummary`: GET `/summary`, return unread_total, category_unread, latest_delivery_id.
-`MarkRead/MarkUnread`: PUT/DELETE `/{delivery_id}/read`.
-`MarkAllRead`: PUT `/read`, request with `before_delivery_id`watermark to prevent new messages from being marked during execution.
-`Archive/Restore`: PUT/DELETE `/{delivery_id}/archive`.
-`DeleteNotification`: DELETE `/{delivery_id}`, only set personal deleted_at.

user API does not accept tenant_id/user_id; All are derived from the authentication context.

### 6.2`system.admin.v1.BaseMessageService`

unified prefix `/api/v1/admin/base/message`:

- `PageBaseMessage/GetBaseMessage/CreateBaseMessage/UpdateBaseMessage/DeleteBaseMessage`, delete only allows drafts.
- `PublishBaseMessage/ScheduleBaseMessage/CancelBaseMessageSchedule/RevokeBaseMessage/RetryBaseMessageDispatch`.
-Form contains the main content, audiences, and version.
-Detail returns the Message count and the status, cursor, attempt, and desensitization error of each Dispatch.

are split into list/get, create/update/delete, publish/schedule, revoke and retry.

### 6.3 `system.admin.v1.BaseMessageCategoryService`

unified prefix `/api/v1/admin/base/message-category`: `PageBaseMessageCategory/GetBaseMessageCategory/CreateBaseMessageCategory/UpdateBaseMessageCategory/DeleteBaseMessageCategory/SetBaseMessageCategoryStatus`; Before deletion, check the Message reference. The referenced category returns a CONFLICT. The classification is maintained only by the default tenant administrator, and other tenants can only read it.

### 6.4`pkg/notification.Publisher`

Narrow interface `Publish(ctx, Command) (messageID,error)`;" Command includes tenant, source, idempotency, categoryCode, priority, content, action, audiences, expiresAt. Publisher resolves platform-enabled categories within the transaction by categoryCode without exposing to the business caller.

-ctx joins the same transaction when it has been bound; otherwise, it creates its own transaction.
- Success only indicates that Message/Dispatch has been committed.
- Return the existing ID with the same idempotent key and the same content; Return a CONFLICT if the content is different.
- Business cannot directly `queue.AddQueue`or spell SSE stream ID.

## 7. Transactions, Queues and fan-out

publish transaction:

```text
BEGIN
insert Message(PUBLISHING/SCHEDULED)
insert Dispatch(PENDING/WAITING) per audience
COMMIT
best-effort wake Relay
```

Relay scans PENDING, expired WAITING, lease expired RUNNING, and delivers to stream `base.message.dispatch`:

```json
{"dispatch_id":123,"tenant_id":1,"expected_version":7}
```

Consumer single batch process:

1. Load Dispatch/Message by id+tenant; The final state task is directly ack.
2. CAS acquires database lease; The old version or RUNNING that has not expired will not be advanced.
3. Press `tenant_id AND user.id > cursor ORDER BY id LIMIT batch_size`to check the user ID.
4. Within a transaction batch insert - ignore Delivery, according to the real new rows in a database cursor/count/version/status, repeat Delivery will not repeat accumulate statistics.
5. After submission, try your best to send it to SSE; If there is a next batch, we will do our best to join the team again.
6. When joining the team fails, Dispatch is still PENDING, and Relay is used for supplementary casting.
After the handler successfully returns, the Core executes XACK+XDEL.

will first release the lease and enter PENDING, and then log off in increments of 1, 2, 4, and 8 minutes. After the fifth attempt fails, it enters "FAILED", and the management end manually retries and resets the count of this round of attempts. The recovery task only scans the expired `next_retry_at`and does not hot loop to preempt tasks that have not reached the retry time.

initial batch_size 500; The handler target is less than half of the visibility timeout. The default global concurrency of Queue is 10. The valid concurrency of in-station messages is first limited to 2 to 4, and then adjusted after pressure testing.

If the product requires a strict "member snapshot at the moment of click to publish", it is necessary to add member history or materialize all users first. This issue does not commit to this. Multiple Selectors overlapping are de-duplicated by the Delivery unique key.

## 8. SSE Authorization and reliability

cannot simply reject the user/authuser of Core; otherwise, App users may subscribe to the operation and maintenance flow.

, construct the Principal: user_id, tenant_id/code, role_id/code, terminal, session/token, expires_at; All from verified tokens.

evolves `Resolve(channelID,userID)`into the equivalent `AuthorizeAndResolve(request,principal,channelID)`:

Flow Strategy
| --- | --- |
: base.notification: Any authenticated user; The server derives tenant+user stream
: codegen: Background user and task owner:
: ops-monitoring: Background user with corresponding Operation/Casbin permissions
: runtime-console: Background user with runtime log permission

independent `/events`resolver and Proto `SSE.Serve`must reuse the same license implementation.

client only transmits `stream=base.notification`. The server generates `base.notification:{tenant_id}:{user_id}`and does not accept the target user channel.

- Use the Authorization header and do not include tokens in the URL.
-401/403 does not retry; Network error logout and reconnection.
- Single connection keeps alive for 20-30 seconds. Set the maximum connection lifetime and re-authenticate before the token expires.
- Event `inbox.changed`contains only change_type, delivery_id, and message_id; The client debounce and then returns to the source.
- Currently, the replay is only in memory and the Publisher does not have Event.ID. The first issue is not guaranteed to be correct by Last-Event-ID.

Phase 2: Redis Pub/Sub can be used to broadcast `notification.changed`to all application nodes, and each node will only push local connections. The Pub/Sub loss is still repaired by database reconciliation. The same Queue consumer group cannot be used for node broadcasting.

## 9. Multi-tenancy and content security

- All Delivery queries are automatically authenticated with tenant_id+user_id; There is no or unauthorized unified RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
- Ordinary tenant administrators can only select the user/role/dept/post of this tenant.
- When the super administrator broadcasts across tenants, it creates an independent Message for each tenant without using tenant_id=0.
- The cache key must contain tenant+user, and the cache will never participate in authorization.
- Re-authenticate the target resource when VIEW_KEY/URL is clicked.
- It is recommended that only VIEW_KEY be opened for the first phase. The stable viewKey is mapped through the three-terminal module and does not accept component file paths.
- title maximum 200, content recommended maximum 20KB; The action JSON is limited by depth, key-value length and total size.
- Uncleaned `v-html`, `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, javascript/data urls are prohibited; Rich text display must undergo HTML cleaning. If external links are open, only HTTPS allow-list is allowed.
- The log does not record tokens, complete body text, sensitive action parameters, or complete user arrays.

## 10. Three-terminal UX

Universal: badge 99+; The list is paginated by the cursor in reverse order by Delivery ID; All/Unread/archived; Classification screening; Batch read; Details show the source, time and clear action. read and archive are independent, and the source is returned after the status of multiple devices changes.

Admin: Header bell + Last 5 Popover + View all; A shared SSE; The management page continues to use `ProTable + FormDialog + ProForm`. Drafts are editable. Once published, they are read-only and display the Dispatch progress/retry if failed.

uni-app: System module self-contained pages, apis and unread stores; "My" display entry and badge; H5 uses fetch SSE; Wechat `onShow`, login completed, return to the front desk, enter the message page to refresh. When the page is visible, it will be polled for 30 to 60 seconds, and the background will stop. core does not rely on notification services.

Taro: The same business semantics as uni-app; The System module self-includes pages, apis and Zustand states; H5 SSE, weapp polling; The action is navigated by stabilizing the viewKey. core does not rely on notification services.

client does not permanently accumulate `unread_delta`: SSE/ polling only triggers Summary, avoiding count drift caused by repetition, out-of-order, and multiple devices.

## 11. Capacity and Reservation

Delivery is the capacity-driven item: `rows = sum(message unique recipient count)`. For example, 100 tenants * 1,000 users * 10 all-staff broadcasts per month = 1 million lines per month. If the rows and indexes are approximately 300 to 600 bytes, then it is about 300 to 600MB per month. When implementing, use real MySQL for measurement.

unread first period MySQL check: tenant+user, read_at NULL, archived/deleted/revoked NULL, and filter Message withdrawal/expiration. Redis cache is added only after the indicator proves that it is necessary. cache misses return to source and provide recalculation/drift monitoring.

suggested retention: Regular 180 days; Safety/compliance 365 days or in accordance with regulations; No updated draft for 90 days; FAILED Dispatch for at least 30 days. Clean up in small batches of 1000 to 5000 lines: Delivery -> Dispatch -> Message. In the first phase, no zoning will be done. After tens of millions of rows are cleared and become a bottleneck, an assessment will be made.

## 12. Failure Recovery and monitoring

Fault Convergence Mode
| --- | --- |
: Crashed after COMMIT but before joining the team; Relay scan PENDING
: Redis unavailable! Dispatch reserved database, dodge and retry
: Consumer crashes; PEL reclaim + DB lease expires
: Crash before ack after batch commit! cursor/version + Delivery unique idempotent
: Stream is trimmed. Dispatch to rebuild the Queue task
| SSE no flow/buffer full/break line | onopen/onShow/Page/Summary back to the source |
: Dispatch Retry exhausted/FAILED + desensitization error + manual Retry, no cursor reset

Message created/published/revoked; Delivery inserted; Dispatch pending/running/failed, oldest pending, batch duration, retry; Redis stream length, PEL, oldest idle, claim, XADD/XACK errors; SSE connection, 401/403, TryPublish false, reconnect; Summary/Page delay.

alerts: oldest pending >5 minutes, FAILED new addition, PEL continuous growth, stream length reaches max 80%, sudden increase in claims, sudden increase in cross-tenant rejections, SSE reconnection storm, slow unread queries.

log field: message_id, dispatch_id, tenant_id, audience, cursor, batch_size, attempt, queue_message_id, trace_id, error_class.

## 13. Verification matrix

- Concurrently publish only one Message with the same idempotent key; There is only one Delivery for overlapping audiences.
- Redis is posted when it is down and relays for final delivery after recovery.
- handler error leave PEL; claim after the time limit; If the ack fails after submission, the Delivery will not be repeated.
- Small max length can still be restored by Dispatch after forced cropping.
- Multiple instances competing for the same Dispatch only have valid lease advances.
- Tenant A/ User A queries other tenants/users for delivery and returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
- MarkAllRead watermark does not mark new messages during execution.
- Withdraw immediately from query/unread exclusion, and add revoked_at in the background.
-admin /authuser/user can subscribe to notification, but user cannot subscribe to the operation and maintenance flow. The two SSE entries are consistent.
- Summary converges after disconnection, buffer full, multiple tabs, and multiple device operations.
-Admin Bright/Dark/Gray/Color weak; uni/Taro H5 SSE; Wechat onShow/ Polling/pagination /viewKey.
-1, 100, 10,000, 100,000 audience pressure testing; Summary/Page EXPLAIN of millions of deliveries; The ordinary CRUD and connection pool are stable during broadcasting.

## 14. Implemented in phases

Stage 0: Freeze four tables/states/apis; Confirm the classification strategy, valid users, department subtrees, and retention period; Validate the index and batch with temporary data.

Stage 1: Four tables, Default Classification, migration /GORM Gen, Publisher, USER/TENANT, Outbox Relay, Redis Consumer, User API, Three-end Inbox and mini-program refresh; Accept Redis fault recovery and tenant isolation.

Phase 2: Message and classification management, timing/recall/retry, ROLE/DEPT/POST, expired receipt cleaning, Monitoring, Admin Header; The acceptance of 10,000-person broadcasting and failure can be restored.

Stage 3: Core Principal/ flow-level authorization, notification SSE, Admin/H5 shared connection, reconnection reconciliation; The acceptance user/authuser can receive notifications but cannot access the operation and maintenance flow.

Stage 4: Redis Pub/Sub multi-node wake-up, increase unread cache/ speed limit/partition by metric, and then consider Save, Snooze, preference and external channels.

## 15. Clearly not to do it

- Delivery success is not defined as SSE success, and Redis Stream is not used as the permanent message repository.
- Does not introduce Asynq/Kafka/ the second Queue, and does not degenerate into an unregulated goroutine when the queue fails.
- Do not create a Redis Stream for each user and do not put large user arrays into the Queue.
- Do not return HTTP only after all staff have fan-out completed in synchronization.
- Do not allow the client to determine the tenant/user stream and do not use the query token.
- not mixed the read/archive/revoke/delete, not in situ modification has been released.
- Does not allow notifications to bypass business permissions and does not support arbitrary HTML/ script/component paths.
- Do not build template markets, complex rule engines or multi-channel platforms in advance.

## 16. Product items to be confirmed

1. Disable whether the user receives new messages; It is recommended not to receive it and not to make up for the historical broadcasts after restoration.
Does
2.DEPT contain subdepartments by default? It is recommended to make an explicit selection.
3. Whether the history of expired messages can be checked; It is recommended that the main inbox be hidden and the management audit be retained.
4. Whether the user's personal deletion is restored; It is recommended that the first installment not be restored but only be soft-hidden.
5. Can security messages be deleted by individuals? It is recommended that it not be deleted during the retention period.
6. Whether the 180-day default retention complies with regulations.
7. Is the external link open in the first phase? It is recommended to support only VIEW_KEY.
8. Whether cross-tenant manual broadcasting will be opened in the first phase; It is suggested that it be closed.

final boundary: MySQL Delivery is the fact, Dispatch is the recoverable Outbox/ cursor, Redis Streams is the asynchronous execution carrier, SSE is the online optimization, and the client backsource constitutes the final consistency closed loop.

# System Overall Design

This article only describes the existing modules, running relationships, and extension boundaries of the current repository. The document entry can be found at [docs/README](README.md). The specific commands are subject to the README and Makefile of each module.

## module

Module Responsibility Product
| --- | --- | --- |
: `backend`: Kratos HTTP/gRPC services, authentication permissions, MFA, open license client, system business, AI, tasks, migration and static hosting. "Go services, OpenAPI
: `kratos-core`: Reusable Kratos host runtime without business Proto. Independent Go module
: `frontend/admin/packages/core`: Management end startup, login, MFA verification, dynamic routing, layout, status and common components. | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core`|
: `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system`: System Management, Personal Center, Security Settings, AI, Open License Client, and Development Tools pages. | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`|
: `frontend/admin/packages/cli`: Create a workspace for the business management end. | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli`|
: `frontend/admin/apps/admin`: The default management host for combining core and System. Private packages: `@liujitcn/kratos-admin`, `backend/data/admin`
: `frontend/uni-app`: Home, Login, My, Profiles, Settings, WebView and AI uni-app application. `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app`, `backend/data/uni-app`
: `frontend/taro-app`: A React/Taro application that shares the backend contract with uni-app, supporting H5 and wechat mini-programs. `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app`, `backend/data/taro-app`
: `backend/migration`: versioned database and initialization data. Embedded SQL

warehouse currently does not have business modules such as the mall, orders, payment, and recommendations.

## Run the relationship

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Admin["管理端宿主"] -->|"/api /events"| Backend["Backend"]
  UniApp["uni-app"] -->|"/api"| Backend
  Taro["Taro app"] -->|"/api"| Backend
  Backend --> DB[("MySQL")]
  Backend --> Redis[("Redis")]
  Backend -->|"/admin/"| AdminFiles["data/admin"]
  Backend -->|"/uni-app/"| UniAppFiles["data/uni-app"]
  Backend -->|"/taro-app/"| TaroFiles["data/taro-app"]
  Module["外部 core.Module"] --> Backend
```

Backend can run independently. Other Core hosts can also be accessed through the publicly available `ProviderSet`, `NewModuleResources`, `NewModules`, `NewTasks`, `NewStreams`and `NewQueueConsumers`. The two forms reuse the same Service, biz and Repository. In-process calls use `Runtime.ClientConn()`, and remote calls use the standard gRPC connection.

## Backend layering

```text
api/proto
  -> api/gen/go
  -> internal/service/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}
  -> internal/biz/{base,system/admin,system/app,...}
  -> internal/data/gen
```

-Proto is the sole contract source for HTTP, gRPC, and checksum front-end types.
-service only performs transmission adaptation and error protection. Business rules are placed in biz, and database access is restricted to data.
-`internal/server/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}`registration transmission service; `internal/module`is responsible for the module adaptation from Admin to Core and the common Wire composite root. `internal/cmd/server`is responsible for the independent process startup entry. `bootstrap.go`provides the external host assembly facade through the public ProviderSet.
- Cross-module data access can only be accessed using the generation client, and internal models, queries, repositories, or cases are not exposed.

Core is responsible for gRPC, HTTP, and MCP registration. Optional Contributor can provide middleware, backend Server, OpenAPI, tasks, queue consumers, SSE, startup scripts, startup hooks, health checks and static resources. `Module`

## Front-end boundary

management end is fixed as:

```text
apps/admin -> packages/modules/system -> packages/core
```

business module provides pages with module prefixes, static page replacement, top tools, user menus, routing options, and naming extensions through `AdminModule`. The default host's module list is only maintained on `apps/admin/src/module-manifest.ts`.

application is an independent pnpm workspace, and the dependency direction is fixed as:

```text
apps/uni-app -> packages/modules/system -> packages/core
```

`KratosAppModule`declares pages, stable view keys and static ICONS through `pages`, `views`and `icons`. The host only maintains `apps/uni-app/src/module-manifest.ts`. The Vite plugin exposed by core scans the module page during the build period, merges `pages.json`and static resources.

The Taro application uses a separate React/Taro workspace, and the dependency direction is:

```text
apps/taro-app -> packages/modules/* -> packages/ui -> packages/core
```

`defineKratosTaroModule()`declares the runtime module, and `defineKratosTaroBuildModule()`provides the build period page description; The runner of `packages/core`generates page wrappers, package configurations, and static resources during development or build, while the host only submits fixed bootstrap pages.

## Contract and generation

command output
| --- | --- |
| `make -C backend api`| `backend/api/gen/go`|
| `make -C backend openapi`| `backend/internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml`|
: `make i18n-openapi`: `backend/internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml`, `openapi.en-US.yaml`, `openapi.zh-TW.yaml`, `openapi.ja-JP.yaml`
; `make -C frontend ts-admin`; `src/rpc`of the core and System on the management end
: `make -C frontend ts-uni-app`: `src/rpc`of uni-app core and system package
; `make -C frontend ts-taro-app`; Taro core and system package `src/rpc`
: `make -C frontend ts`: Generate all `src/rpc`for the management end, uni-app and Taro at once
| `make -C backend gorm-gen`| `backend/internal/data/gen`|
| `make -C backend wire`| `backend/internal/cmd/server/wire_gen.go`|

interface should be completed by following the steps: "Proto → Generate → service/biz → Front-end Request and Page → Migrate Permission". The generated file is not modified manually.

## Data and permissions

migration resource is fixed and maintained at `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/<data-source?>`. MFA, open licensing and their permission initialization are all directly written into `v0.0.1`; New features will also be updated to this initialization version. No higher versions will be added or incremental migrations will be made. When starting up, first execute the GORM automatic table creation according to the configuration, then execute the initialization SQL, and finally synchronize `base_api`, tenant role menu and Casbin policy from OpenAPI and menu relationships.

authentication uses JWT access/refresh token; Password transmission uses a one-time RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM hybrid encryption. The determination of tenants and permissions is based on the server side.

## Document Index

: Subject/Document
| --- | --- |
: backend and Core: [backend README](../backend/README.md), independent `kratos-core`repository]
management end [frontend/admin README](../frontend/admin/README.md)
/ application side [frontend/uni-app README](../frontend/uni-app/README.md)
: taro Application [frontend/taro-app README](../frontend/taro-app/README.md)
: New Capability Access [Service Access Guide ](服务接入指南.md)
: Database [Database and Initialization Data Design ](数据库与初始化数据设计.md)
Interface Verification [Interface Parameter Verification Design ](接口参数校验设计.md)
[Login and password Encryption process ](登录与密码加密流程.md)
: AI: [AI Assistant Design ](AI助手设计.md)
: Internal Message [Internal Message design ](站内信设计.md)
Management End components [Front-end Component List ](前端组件清单.md)
International Design [Final Internationalization Plan ](国际化最终方案.md)
New Languages added [International Language Extension Guide ](国际化语言扩展指南.md)

# frontend/admin

management backend adopts pnpm workspace and is organized as "thin host + core base + optional business modules + engineering tools". The host is only responsible for composition and initiation. Pages, requests, RPC types, and business dependencies belong to the corresponding module packages.
The
System module includes message management, message classification, and personal inbox, and displays unread messages through the top tool.
The
Core layout provides the ability to lock the screen in the avatar menu, and the lock screen password digest is persisted only during the current lock screen session.

is fixed as `app -> business module -> core`. core does not depend on any business modules, and business modules do not reference each other by default. When reuse is indeed necessary, it can only be done through the Interface disclosed by the other party's `package.json#exports`.

## Directory responsibilities

```text
frontend/admin
├── apps/admin                        # 装配当前全部 module 的默认宿主
├── packages/core                     # @liujitcn/kratos-admin-core 底座
│   ├── src/api/{base,system}         # 按 Proto 领域组织的底座请求
│   ├── src/components                # 公共组件
│   ├── src/layouts                   # 布局
│   ├── src/modules                   # 模块注册 interface
│   ├── src/rpc                       # 登录、菜单和底座能力 Proto 类型
│   └── src/views                     # 登录与静态错误页面
├── packages/modules/system           # @liujitcn/kratos-admin-system
│   └── src/{api,rpc,views}           # API 与 RPC 按 Proto 领域层级维护
├── packages/cli                      # @liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli
│   └── templates/business-workspace  # 完整 pnpm workspace 模板
├── internal/vite-config              # 当前仓库宿主构建配置
├── internal/tsconfig                 # 共享 TypeScript 配置
├── internal/lint-config              # 共享 Oxlint 配置
├── scripts/build-package.mjs          # core 与业务模块的 npm 发布构建器
├── package.json                       # workspace 命令与公共开发依赖
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
├── tsconfig.json                      # workspace TypeScript 路径映射
└── turbo.json
```

`apps/admin/src/module-manifest.ts`is the sole source of the default host module configuration, and it also declares the runtime loader, Vite scan package, and pre-built dependencies. `apps/admin/src/modules.ts`loads and exports by default all the modules of the current host. The business view directory of core only retains the login page. The default static implementations for 403, 404, 500, and Pending are provided by core. The Personal Center, AI Assistant and system management pages are all provided by `systemAdminModule`. The personal center and AI assistant are dynamically registered for routes through the backend menu, and static business routes are not declared in the host.

## root directory file

: Path: Function
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
: `apps/`: A collection of runnable management end hosts; The current default host is `admin`. |
: `packages/core/`: publishable management end runtime, layout, components, and base pages. |
: `packages/modules/`: A collection of optional business modules, where apis and pages are maintained together within the modules. |
: `packages/cli/`: Standalone business workspace command-line tools and templates that can be published. |
: `internal/`: Vite, TypeScript, and lint configuration packages available only for the current source code repository. |
: `scripts/build-package.mjs`: Generate a copy of the npm package source code and TypeScript declarations, and convert the internal source code aliases of core. |
: `package.json`: Declare workspace commands, tool dependencies, Node and pnpm versions. |
: `pnpm-lock.yaml`: Fix the dependency resolution results for the entire workspace. |
: `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: Declare the workspace packages under `apps`, `packages`and `internal`. |
: `tsconfig.json`: Inherit the shared configuration and declare the source code path mapping of this repository. |
: `turbo.json`: Define the relationship between development, build, release build and type checking tasks. |
: `AGENTS.md`: Collaboration and code constraints for the management end directory. |
: `.editorconfig`: Universal indentation, line break and character set rules for editors. |
: `.gitignore`: Rule for ignoring local products on the management end. |
: `.oxlintignore`: Oxlint scanning exclusion rules. |
: `.prettierignore`, `.prettierrc.cjs`: Prettier exclusion scope and format configuration. |
: `.stylelintignore`, `.stylelintrc.cjs`: Stylelint Exclusion range and style rules. |
: `lint-staged.config.cjs`: The configuration for checking the temporary files on the management end used by the repository Git hook. |
: `commitlint.config.cjs`: Git commit information verification rules. |
: `postcss.config.cjs`: PostCSS and browser prefix processing configuration. |
: `README.md`: workspace architecture, common commands, and module integration instructions. |

Each subdirectory containing `package.json`has the same level `README.md`, which is used to describe the responsibilities of the files and directories within the package.

management end publishes `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core`, `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`and
`@liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli`. The default host, `@liujitcn/kratos-admin`, is a private package and is not accessed
npm packaging and publishing list.

## Development and construction

```bash
cd frontend/admin
pnpm install
pnpm dev
pnpm test
pnpm type:check
pnpm lint:oxlint
pnpm build
pnpm build:package
```

directory, common processes can also be executed through the upper-level Makefile: `frontend/admin`

```bash
make -C .. run-admin
make -C .. check-admin
make -C .. build-admin
make -C .. package-admin
```

is `http://localhost:8848`. The environment variable is located at `apps/admin/.env*`. The API proxy for the development mode and the production build output directory are uniformly managed by the host Vite configuration. The current production build is written into `backend/data/admin`.

management end adopts the Cookie only mode of the browser: The refresh token is written by the backend to the HttpOnly Cookie with a narrowed Path. The access token is only saved in the page memory and is not written to `localStorage`or `sessionStorage`. The application startup will proactively clean up the persistent access tokens left over from the old version and determine whether silent session resumption is needed through a non-sensitive expiration time Cookie.

## Internationalization

management end are automatically discovered by the core and System JSON language packages, and the language key and placeholder set are verified during module registration. The login page and the top toolbar share the locale store. Switching languages does not refresh the page, and the current route, query parameters, and unsubmitted forms are retained.

as `kratos-admin:locale`. Axios, refresh token, native fetch, SSE and Swagger requests are all sent uniformly to `Accept-Language`; The dynamic menu and dictionary are returned from the back end by locale. When the translation of the current language is missing, it reverts to the main language. To add a new language, you need to synchronize the backend internationalization directory, the six front-end language pack directories of the three workspaces, and then execute `make i18n-sync`in the root directory of the repository. The registration file and Day.js mapping are generated by the script. For specific procedures, please refer to [International Language Extension Guide ](../../docs/国际化语言扩展指南.md)

API is organized by Proto first-level domains into directories such as `api/base`and `api/system`. RPC retains complete Proto levels such as `rpc/base/v1`and `rpc/system/admin/v1`. RPC types are placed according to the actual consumer affiliation: core retains the service types required for login, menus, user information, and startup period capabilities; The System itself includes system management, personal center, AI and its dependent types. After modifying Proto, execute `make -C frontend ts-admin`in the root directory of the repository. The command will clean up and generate RPCS for core and System respectively based on two Buf configurations. When it is necessary to generate RPC for three front ends at once, execute `make -C frontend ts`. When the server-side contract has not been finely split, the same generation file may temporarily contain methods that are not called by the current package. Do not write the generation file by hand.

core uses `@/*`. The business module uses `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/*`and its own package name. Page jumps between modules use Vue Router, and cross-directory relative references are prohibited for code reuse.

root TypeScript path and the host Vite source code alias are only used to map the `package.json#exports`declared entry points for each npm package. The core implementation internally uses `@/*`, and the business modules use package names to reference the public entry.

## Module interface

core exports `bootstrapAdminApp`, `defineAdminModule`, `setAdminDocumentTitle`, view registry, as well as top tools, user menus, and route behavior extensions. The browser title should prioritize the `sysName`returned by the public configuration interface, and the host environment variable should serve as a fallback in case of loading failure. The dynamic page can be accessed by declaring the name and page loader of the business module entry

```ts
import type { Component } from "vue";
import { defineAdminModule } from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core";

const views = import.meta.glob<{ default: Component }>("./views/**/*.vue");

export const orderAdminModule = defineAdminModule({
  name: "order",
  views
});
```

business page only registers the module prefix path. Therefore, `views/list/index.vue`is uniformly resolved by `order/list/index`and does not provide `list/index`as an alias without a prefix. The `component`in the backend menu must write the complete module path. Even if different Modules contain pages with the same name `views`, they will not overwrite each other. The host declares the module in `src/module-manifest.ts`, `src/modules.ts`loads and exports all modules by default, and the Vite build configuration is derived from the manifest:

```ts
export const adminModuleManifest = [
  {
    packageName: "@order/admin-module",
    load: async () => (await import("@order/admin-module")).orderAdminModule
  }
];
```

### Replace static pages

core exposes the fixed view keys of all static pages through `ADMIN_STATIC_VIEWS`:

: Properties/View keys
| -------------- | --------------- |
| `LOGIN`| `login/index`|
| `FORBIDDEN`| `error/403`|
| `NOT_FOUND`| `error/404`|
| `SERVER_ERROR`| `error/500`|
| `PENDING`| `error/pending`|

business module explicitly maps any of its pages to a fixed view key through `staticViews`. The later-registered module replaces the earlier-registered implementation:

```ts
import { ADMIN_STATIC_VIEWS, defineAdminModule } from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core";

export const orderAdminModule = defineAdminModule({
  name: "order",
  staticViews: {
    [ADMIN_STATIC_VIEWS.NOT_FOUND]: () => import("./components/NotFound.vue"),
    [ADMIN_STATIC_VIEWS.PENDING]: () => import("./components/Pending.vue")
  }
});
```

ordinary `views`is always isolated by module name, while only `staticViews`is replaceable Seam. The npm Interface of core only exposes module access, component whitelistes, and stable entry points such as `request`, `navigation`, `table`, `security`, and `stores/runtime`. Business modules must not rely on the internal paths of core's source code.

## Create a business project

CLI is also pnpm workspace itself, including an independent host and publishable business module packages:

```bash
pnpm dlx @liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli create shop-admin --module shop
pnpm dlx @liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli create shop-admin --module shop,order

# 当前仓库开发
pnpm module:create ../shop-admin --module shop
pnpm module:create ../shop-admin --module shop,order
pnpm module:create ../shop-admin --module shop --module order
```

:

```text
shop-admin
├── apps/admin
│   └── README.md
├── packages/modules/shop
│   └── README.md
├── packages/modules/order
│   └── README.md
├── scripts/build-package.mjs
├── package.json
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
├── README.md
├── tsconfig.json
└── turbo.json
```

CLI first imports `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`, and then imports and creates its own module in the order of the `--module`parameter. `--module`can be reused and also accepts comma-separated names. `--with`only adds additional published modules to the host combination, does not create their source code, and does not create implicit dependencies between business modules. The CLI refuses to overwrite an existing directory.

`frontend/taro-app`is an independent pnpm workspace that implements the same application functionality and visualizations as `frontend/uni-app`with React 18 and Taro 4. Currently, H5 and wechat mini-programs are supported, including home page, login (including TOTP/WebAuthn MFA), protocol, WebView, personal center, Settings, personal profile, AI assistant and in-site message inbox. It does not include mall, orders, payment or recommendation services.

## Workspace

```text
frontend/taro-app
├── apps/taro-app                 # 私有 Taro 宿主，不发布
├── packages/core                 # 运行时、基础页面和构建 runner

├── pnpm-workspace.yaml           # workspace 包范围

```

is fixed as:

```text
apps/taro-app -> packages/modules/* -> packages/ui -> packages/core
```

core does not rely on UI or business modules; system only reuses capabilities through the public exports of core and UI. The host is only responsible for the combination of modules and platform configuration.

## page assembly

`apps/taro-app/src/module-manifest.ts`is the unique module list, and the declaration order determines the priority of page, stable `viewKey`and icon coverage. The module declares runtime capabilities through `defineKratosTaroModule()`and exposes the build page description through `defineKratosTaroBuildModule()`.

```bash
pnpm dev:mp-weixin

```

```bash
make -C .. build-taro-app    # H5 构建
```

- wechat mini-program development and production products are uniformly written into `apps/taro-app/dist/mp-weixin`, and the wechat developer tools can directly import this directory.

module that require a fixed path should be uniformly placed in `src/static`. Taro are automatically discovered by the core and System JSON language packs, and the key and placeholder sets are verified during module registration. The dynamic menu follows the title parsed by the backend and reverts to the main language when the current language translation is missing. ## CLI

```bash

pnpm dlx @liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-cli create shop-app --module shop,order
pnpm dlx @liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-cli create my-app --with @acme/customer-module
```
